message.content:
You are doing a code review of an Excel VBA macro codebase. This is NOT a diff review — all the .bas files are newly written/untracked in git, so review them as a fresh audit of correctness against a written spec (CLAUDE.md in the same directory), not against a prior version.

Working directory: "C:\Users\lutfi\OneDrive\Desktop\TTSH Intern\Coding projects\Monthly Report VBA"

Read CLAUDE.md in that directory FIRST — it is the full spec (processing steps, architecture conventions, known VBA gotchas). Then read every .bas file in that directory:
- MainMacro.bas (orchestration)
- Helpers.bas (FindColByHeader, NormHeader, PickFile, CreateConfigSheet, etc.)
- FilterFileA.bas (File A: FC Mode filter, cancelled-admission delete, sort, dedup prep)
- FilterFileB.bas (File B: Inflight Missed FC Report processing)
- DeduplicateEncounters.bas (priority scoring, dedup flag, mass delete, Inflight exception)
- BuildOutput.bas (output sheet generation, colour-coded summary, % breakdown)
- FilePickerForm.bas (dashboard UserForm)
- ProgressForm.bas (progress bar)

Also skim docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md for the authoritative answers to Q1-Q8 (the process flow doc referenced by CLAUDE.md) so you can check the code actually implements what was decided, not just what CLAUDE.md's prose says (CLAUDE.md explicitly says the process flow doc's answers override/refine some of its own steps, e.g. the Voided/Deleted denominator treatment and the Inflight exception in Step 9).

Focus your review on real, concrete bugs — things that will produce a wrong report or crash the macro — not style nits. Specifically verify:

1. **FindColByHeader discipline**: every place a column is used, is FindColByHeader's return checked for 0 before indexing? A miss (col=0) used as an array/range index either throws or silently reads the wrong column.
2. **IIf() non-short-circuit gotcha**: any `IIf(cond, arr(i,col), ...)` pattern where col could be 0 or i could be out of bounds — CLAUDE.md explicitly warns against this.
3. **Priority scoring table (Step 5)**: does the code's priority number assignment match the table in CLAUDE.md exactly (1-6 for named statuses, 98 for Draft/other, 99 for Voided/Deleted-only via substring match)? Check the substring/exact-match logic for each status string, including the EN DASH gotcha noted for FC Mode ("Financial Counselling – AH" uses U+2013, not a hyphen).
4. **Dedup flag (Step 6)**: lowest priority wins; tie-break is LARGEST (latest) FC ID, not smallest. Verify the actual comparison operators.
5. **Step 7 mass delete conditions**: all three conditions (encounter is a duplicate, some other row for that encounter has Completed/Acknowledgement-by-other-means, current row's status is neither) must hold simultaneously — check the boolean logic isn't accidentally OR'd or missing a condition.
6. **Step 9 Inflight exception (narrowed 2026-07-29)**: exception only overrides plain lowest-priority-wins when BOTH (a) a non-Inflight candidate was created by ED/EDFC staff, AND (b) the winner among non-Inflight candidates has priority <= 2. Verify both conditions are actually ANDed and gate the override, not just one of them.
7. **Step 10 EM/EL split**: per the REVISED 2026-07-30 spec, split is by Admission Type ALONE (Emergency vs Elective Inpatient prefix-matched on normalised "ELECTIVE INPA"), with NO Point of Care gating on the EL side. Check the code doesn't still gate EL admissions by Point of Care (that was called out as a past bug that tested wrong: EL=12 vs manual count of 627).
8. **Denominator calc**: unique encounter count from cleaned File A INCLUDING priority-99 (Voided/Deleted) encounters, PLUS missed FC count from File B (or manual entry). Verify Voided/Deleted rows aren't accidentally excluded from the denominator anywhere (this was reversed from an earlier design — Q4 reopened).
9. **Sort correctness (Step 3)**: ascending by Latest CCF Creation Date-Time then Encounter Number, so the latest FC ID lands at the BOTTOM of each encounter group — check whatever later code relies on "last row in group = latest" actually holds given the sort direction used.
10. **Dual-source sync**: since FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt is supposed to be a byte-for-byte concatenation mirror of the .bas files (per CLAUDE.md's "CRITICAL: dual-source maintenance" section), spot check whether the .txt file actually matches the current .bas files, or whether it has drifted (this is a common failure mode called out explicitly in CLAUDE.md).
11. **Non-ASCII characters** in FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt — CLAUDE.md requires clean ASCII (no smart quotes, no en/em dashes except where deliberately needed for data matching like the EN DASH FC Mode comparison). Check for stray smart quotes/unicode that would corrupt when pasted into the VBA editor.
12. Any other correctness bugs you find while reading (off-by-one loop bounds, wrong comparison operators, array bounds, Scripting.Dictionary case-sensitivity per CLAUDE.md's warning, etc).

For each real bug found, report: file path, line number, one-sentence summary of the defect, and a concrete failure scenario (specific input -> specific wrong output). Do not report style preferences or hypothetical edge cases with no realistic trigger. Only report things you have verified by actually reading the relevant code — quote the exact line(s) that prove the bug in your findings.

Output a JSON array of findings (file, line, summary, failure_scenario) sorted most-severe first. If you find nothing wrong in a category, don't mention it — only report actual verified bugs.

<system-reminder>
Other agents active in this session, addressable via SendMessage({to: name, message}): main, code-review.
</system-reminder>

1	# FC Completion Report -- Process Flow (For Review)
2	
3	This document describes how the new FC Completion Report tool will process the
4	monthly eFC exports and calculate the completion statistics. Please read through
5	and confirm whether the rules below match how the report should actually work --
6	specific questions are listed at the end.
7	
8	> **2026-07-29 conflict resolution note:** this document had silently diverged
9	> from "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" (the authoritative
10	> source) by the time Q1-Q8 below were confirmed on 2026-06-18. Two of those
11	> answers were revisited and revised against the guide: **Q1** (EM/EL split)
12	> now requires the Point of Care condition the guide always specified, and
13	> **Q3** (Inflight duplicate exception) was narrowed to match the guide's
14	> intent rather than the broader rule this document previously described. See
15	> the updated Section 2 steps 6 and 9, the priority table, and Section 5A
16	> below -- these now match the guide and the shipped code.
17	>
18	> **2026-07-30 reconciliation note:** the macro was validated against a real
19	> export (FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx, June 2026, 7,434 rows) and the
20	> team's manually produced report for the same month. Two more reversions
21	> came out of that reconciliation:
22	>
23	> - **Q1 (EM/EL split) reverted back to its ORIGINAL 2026-06-18 answer.** The
24	>   2026-07-29 Point of Care gate was tested against the real export and
25	>   produced EL=12 instead of the manual report's EL=627 -- the gate was
26	>   wrong. EM/EL is Admission Type alone again; the NCID Point of Care list is
27	>   now purely informational (an "NCID Ward" breakdown column, an "of which
28	>   NCID wards" summary sub-block, and a warning for unmatched "NCID" Point of
29	>   Care values) -- see the revised Section 2 step 9 and Section 6.
30	> - **Q4 (Voided/Deleted-only encounters) is REOPENED.** The manual report
31	>   includes them (56 this month: 8 EM + 48 EL); excluding them (the
32	>   2026-06-18 answer) disagreed with actual practice. The macro now counts
33	>   them IN the denominator and IN "not completed", with their own Summary
34	>   row -- see the revised Section 2 step 8 and Section 5A. This is NOT a
35	>   final answer, just practice winning over the original confirmation until
36	>   the team weighs in -- see Q4 in Section 7.
37	>
38	> Also added this run: a reconciliation waterfall on the Summary sheet (so
39	> the macro's math can be checked line-by-line against a manual count), a
40	> small-denominator guard (percentages suppressed under n=30), a roster
41	> coverage guard (warns/aborts before an empty or unmatched staff roster
42	> silently reports 100% "Others"), and roster bootstrap/export/import tools
43	> (`SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare`, `ExportStaffRoster`, `ImportStaffRoster`,
44	> all Alt+F8). See Section 4 and Section 6 below.
45	
46	---
47	
48	## 1. Inputs
49	
50	Two eFC exports are used:
51	
52	- **File A -- FC Summary Report**: one row per FC ID, full month, Admission Type
53	  Emergency (+ Elective Inpatient for NCID AO).
54	- **File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report** (OPTIONAL): Inflight FC Report with the
55	  "Missed FC" indicator ticked. If File B is not provided, the tool asks for a
56	  manual Missed FC count instead (the eFC dashboard workaround the guide
57	  documents), attributed entirely to Emergency (EM) since the dashboard
58	  workaround doesn't distinguish Elective/NCID AO missed cases.
59	
60	---
61	
62	## 2. File A -- Cleaning and Deduplication
63	
64	The tool processes File A in this order:
65	
66	1. **Remove non-FC rows.** Keep only rows where FC Mode is "Financial Counselling -
67	   AH" or "Financial Counselling - Downtime". (Removes Shopper-mode and other
68	   irrelevant rows.)
69	
70	2. **Remove cancelled admissions.** Any row where Admission Status = "Cancelled" is
71	   dropped.
72	
73	3. **Rank each remaining row by FC Status**, using this priority order (1 = best,
74	   higher number = worse):
75	
76	   | Priority | FC Status |
77	   |---|---|
78	   | 1 | Completed |
79	   | 2 | Acknowledgement by other means |
80	   | 3 | Attempted - Virtual FC Completed, pending signature |
81	   | 4 | Attempted - patient/NOK declines to sign |
82	   | 5 | Attempted - Patient is unable to sign |
83	   | 6 | Attempted - unable to complete |
84	   | 98 | Anything else not explicitly listed above -- Draft variants, blanks, typos, new eFC statuses. Still IN the denominator (not completed), NOT excluded. |
85	   | 99 | Voided / Deleted ONLY (matched by substring, e.g. "Voided", "Deleted by Admin") -- excluded from the denominator entirely (see step 8). |
86	
87	   The distinct FC Status text values landing on priority 98 are collected and
88	   printed as a warning block on the Summary sheet each run, so a typo or a
89	   brand-new eFC status is visible instead of silently shrinking the
90	   denominator.
91	
92	4. **Group rows by Encounter Number** and sort each group so the most recently
93	   created CCF is last.
94	
95	5. **Highlight duplicate encounter numbers in red** -- this is just a visual aid so
96	   staff can see at a glance which encounters had more than one FC ID.
97	
98	6. **Pick one row to keep per encounter.** For each encounter with more than one FC
99	   ID:
100	   - The default rule is **plain lowest-priority-wins**: across ALL candidate rows,
101	     keep the one with the best (lowest) priority number from the table above. If
102	     there's a tie, keep the one with the **larger FC ID** (i.e. the more recently
103	     created one).
104	   - The **Inflight exception** only overrides this default when BOTH hold:
105	     a) at least one of the *non*-Inflight rows in the group was created by an
106	        **ED/EDFC** staff member (per the staff roster), AND
107	     b) the winner that would result from setting the Inflight row(s) aside has
108	        priority 1 or 2 (Completed / Acknowledgement by other means).
109	     When both hold, the Inflight-created row(s) are set aside and the winner is
110	     picked from the remaining non-Inflight candidates instead. If either
111	     condition fails, the plain lowest-priority rule from above stands -- the
112	     Inflight row is treated like any other candidate.
113	   - If an encounter only has one FC ID to begin with, that row is always kept
114	     (even if its priority is 99).
115	   - The tool counts how many encounter groups used the Inflight exception, and
116	     how many were blocked by the priority<=2 guard (fell back to the plain
117	     rule) -- both counts are reported in the final summary dialog and on the
118	     Methodology sheet.
119	
120	7. **Delete every row that wasn't kept.** This replaces the old manual "review
121	   duplicates and delete" step entirely -- the tool does it automatically using the
122	   rule above.
123	
124	8. **Encounters where the only surviving FC ID is Voided/Deleted (priority 99)**
125	   -- **REVISED 2026-07-30 (Q4 reopened):** these are now counted IN the
126	   denominator and IN "not completed", with their own "Voided/Deleted only"
127	   row on the Summary sheet (this matches the manual report -- 56 this month:
128	   8 EM + 48 EL -- but disagrees with the original 2026-06-18 answer, which
129	   excluded them entirely. See Q4 in Section 7.) The tool still reports the
130	   count separately so staff can double-check whether an FC is still needed
131	   for those encounters.
132	
133	9. **Split the remaining rows into two sheets, based on Admission Type
134	   ALONE** -- **REVISED 2026-07-30 (Q1 reverted to its original 2026-06-18
135	   answer):**
136	   - **Emergency** admissions -> "EM" sheet.
137	   - **Elective Inpatient** admissions -> "EL" sheet. Every Elective Inpatient
138	     encounter goes to EL -- there is no Point of Care condition. (The
139	     2026-07-29 version gated EL on the Config "NCID EL Point of Care" list;
140	     tested against a real export it produced EL=12 against a manual count of
141	     627, so the gate has been removed.)
142	   - The NCID Point of Care list is still on the Config sheet, but is now
143	     purely informational: it drives an "NCID Ward" Yes/No column on the EL
144	     sheet and an "of which NCID wards" summary sub-block (so NCID AO's own
145	     subset of EL is still visible), plus a warning if any Point of Care value
146	     containing "NCID" isn't in the configured list (so a new ward is never
147	     silently missed).
148	   - Any row that is neither Emergency nor Elective Inpatient (shouldn't
149	     normally happen, given the export filters) is set aside and reported
150	     separately so nothing silently disappears.
151	   - As an extra check (informational only, doesn't change which sheet a row goes
152	     to), the tool flags rows where the bucket "looks wrong" -- e.g. an Emergency
153	     row that was actually closed by an NCID AO staff member, or an Elective row
154	     closed by ED/EDFC or Inflight staff. This is just a flag for staff to review.
155	
156	---
157	
158	## 3. File B -- Cleaning (Missed FC List) -- OPTIONAL
159	
160	File B is now optional. If it isn't provided, the tool asks for a manual
161	Missed FC count (the eFC dashboard workaround) instead, and skips steps 1-3
162	below entirely -- everything after this section that reads "the missed FC
163	count" uses the manual entry, attributed to Emergency (EM), when File B is
164	absent.
165	
166	1. **Keep only rows where "Missed FC" = Yes.**
167	
168	2. **Remove Cancelled and Planned admissions** (Cancelled = upstream cancellation;
169	   Planned = patient never actually admitted).
170	
171	3. **Flag EDVW discharges** (Point Of Care = "TTSH Virtual Ward" and Accommodation
172	   Code = "EDVW") with an informational column -- these are still counted as missed
173	   FC like everything else, just labelled so staff can see how many are EDVW cases.
174	
175	4. **Everything left over = genuinely missed FC.** This becomes the follow-up list
176	   for EDFC/Inflight/NCID AO, and each row counts toward the "Missed FC" total.
177	
178	---
179	
180	## 4. Staff Roster and NCID Point of Care (Config)
181	
182	Two independent editable lists live on the Config sheet:
183	
184	- **Staff Name -> Team** -- where Team is one of: ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO,
185	  ICH PSO, Admin/Managers. Anyone not on the list is treated as "Others" (e.g.
186	  SOC staff). Used in three places:
187	  - Step 6 above (deciding which duplicate row to keep -- the Inflight exception).
188	  - The EM/EL "looks wrong" flag in Step 9 above.
189	  - The "who closed the CCF" percentage breakdown (Section 5 below).
190	
191	- **NCID EL Point of Care** -- the exact Point of Care ward text values (NCID
192	  wards E and F). **REVISED 2026-07-30:** no longer gates the EL split (Step 9
193	  above) -- purely informational (the "NCID Ward" column/sub-block and the
194	  unmatched-value warning). Ships prefilled with the 10 confirmed ward values,
195	  still user-editable.
196	
197	Because the staff roster gates team attribution, the Inflight duplicate
198	exception, and the "who closed the CCF" breakdown all at once, an empty or
199	badly-matched roster used to fail silently (everyone defaults to "Others",
200	and the report just shows 100% "Others" with no error). As of 2026-07-30 the
201	tool runs a **roster coverage guard** right after File A cleaning: it
202	measures what fraction of encounters map to a named team.
203	- **0% coverage:** asks whether to continue with completion statistics only
204	  (team attribution and the numerator table are suppressed entirely, not
205	  shown as rows of zeros) or abort.
206	- **Under 70%:** proceeds, but lists the unmatched staff names (biggest first)
207	  on the Summary sheet so you know which names to add.
208	- **70% or above:** proceeds silently; unmatched names are still listed on the
209	  Staff Roster Check sheet.
210	
211	Three Alt+F8 tools help keep the roster populated and portable across the
212	report's monthly hand-off between team leads:
213	- **SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare** -- bootstraps a starting roster from an FC
214	  Summary Report export, guessing each staff member's team from their
215	  dominant Point of Care. Never overwrites a team you've already entered;
216	  low-confidence guesses (dominant Point of Care under 50%) are flagged.
217	- **ExportStaffRoster / ImportStaffRoster** -- round-trips the roster through
218	  a CSV file.
219	
220	---
221	
222	## 5. How the Numbers Are Calculated
223	
224	**Denominator** (total encounters counted) = (unique encounters kept after
225	File A deduplication -- **including** Voided/Deleted-only, priority 99, as of
226	the 2026-07-30 Q4 reopening) + (genuinely missed FC count, from File B or
227	manual entry -- Section 3). The Summary sheet shows the full derivation as a
228	row-by-row reconciliation waterfall (rows loaded -> after FC Mode filter ->
229	after Cancelled filter -> unique encounters -> less duplicates -> encounters
230	carried forward -> plus missed FC -> = denominator), with a visible
231	balance-check row.
232	
233	**A. Completion status breakdown** (counts and % of denominator) -- six bands,
234	plus a "Not completed (total)" subtotal so a single headline figure is still
235	available. Blocks with a denominator under 30 (e.g. the "of which NCID wards"
236	sub-block) show counts only -- percentages are suppressed as misleading at
237	that sample size.
238	
239	| Colour | Meaning | Based on priority |
240	|---|---|---|
241	| Green | FC Completed with written acknowledgement | 1, 2 |
242	| Pink | CCF explained but not signed | 3 |
243	| Light Green | Attempted, no further follow-up | 4, 5 |
244	| Orange | FC not completed | 6 |
245	| White/none | Draft only -- no FC outcome | 98 |
246	| Voided/Deleted only (uncoloured) | Only surviving FC ID was Voided/Deleted (Q4 reopened, 2026-07-30) | 99 |
247	| Grey | Missed FC -- no FC ID created | File B / manual entry |
248	
249	"Not completed (total)" = Orange + White/none + Voided/Deleted only + Grey.
250	Splitting Drafts (priority 98) and Voided/Deleted (priority 99) into their
251	own bands does not change this total or the overall completion percentage --
252	only the presentation. Each Summary block also shows a visible "Total" row so
253	a mismatch between the bands and the denominator would be obvious.
254	
255	**B. Who closed the CCF** -- each File A encounter is categorized by the team of
256	whoever has "Latest CCF Creation User" (using the staff roster). If that field is
257	blank (i.e. no CCF was ever generated -- pure Draft), the tool falls back to "FC
258	Created By" instead, so the encounter is still credited to *some* team rather than
259	disappearing from this breakdown. File B's missed-FC count becomes its own "CCF not
260	generated" bucket.
261	
262	**C. Numerator detail table** (counts used for team workload reporting):
263	
264	| Metric | Based on | Team |
265	|---|---|---|
266	| FC completed by EDFC (initial) | FC Created By | ED/EDFC |
267	| FC completed by EDFC (full CCF) | Latest CCF Creation User | ED/EDFC |
268	| FC completed by Inflight | Latest CCF Creation User | Inflight |
269	| FC completed by NCID AO | Latest CCF Creation User | NCID AO |
270	
271	**General principle:** when a case is ambiguous or borderline, the tool counts it as
272	**not completed / missed** rather than completed. The idea is that it's better to
273	slightly overstate outstanding work than to understate it.
274	
275	All of A, B, and C above are calculated three times: once for Emergency, once for
276	Elective/NCID AO, and once combined.
277	
278	---
279	
280	## 6. What You'll Get (Output File)
281	
282	A new Excel workbook with:
283	
284	1. **EM sheet** -- cleaned, deduplicated Emergency encounters (one row per
285	   encounter). Always produced. Includes an informational "NCID Ward" column.
286	2. **EL sheet** -- same, for every Elective Inpatient encounter (Admission
287	   Type alone, no Point of Care gate as of 2026-07-30). Always produced.
288	   Includes an informational "NCID Ward" Yes/No column.
289	3. **Missed FC sheet** -- the follow-up list from File B. SKIPPED if File B
290	   was not provided (Section 3).
291	4. **Summary sheet** -- a reconciliation waterfall (Section 5), the
292	   colour-coded breakdown and % breakdowns for EM, EL, "of which NCID wards"
293	   (a subset of EL), and Combined, plus footnotes for anything excluded
294	   (Voided/Deleted-only encounters, unrecognised Admission Types, encounters
295	   lost entirely to the FC Mode filter, Missed FC source, Inflight exception
296	   counts), a warning block listing any genuinely unrecognised FC Status
297	   values seen (known "Draft" variants are excluded from this warning -- they
298	   are expected), a warning for any "NCID" Point of Care value not in the
299	   Config list, and -- if roster coverage is under 70% -- a list of unmatched
300	   staff names, biggest first.
301	5. **Methodology sheet** -- a plain-language explanation of exactly which rule
302	   counted each encounter as completed/missed, with the actual numbers for this
303	   month, so every figure can be traced back to a rule.
304	6. **Staff Roster Check sheet** -- roster entries not seen in this export, AND
305	   (2026-07-30) names seen in this export that didn't match any roster entry.
306	
307	---
308	
309	## 7. Please Confirm
310	
311	> **Status (2026-07-29):** all eight questions below were originally confirmed
312	> 2026-06-18. Q1 and Q3 were subsequently revisited against "Guide to monthly
313	> processing of report 3.docx" (the authoritative source, which this document
314	> had silently diverged from) and revised -- see the note at the top of this
315	> document. Their answers below have been updated to match the guide and the
316	> shipped code; Q2, Q4-Q8 stand as originally confirmed (Q2's priority *table*
317	> was separately revised for Decision 2 -- see Section 2 above -- but the
318	> ranking order itself is unchanged).
319	
320	1. **EM/EL split** -- is it correct that the only thing that decides whether
321	   an encounter goes into the EM (Emergency) or EL (Elective Inpatient) report
322	   is the **Admission Type** field, with no other conditions (e.g. ward/Point
323	   Of Care)? ~~**REVISED 2026-07-29:** no -- Elective Inpatient rows also
324	   require Point of Care to match the configured NCID ward E/F list (Section
325	   2, step 9).~~ **REVISED AGAIN 2026-07-30 -- back to YES, the original
326	   answer was correct.** Tested against the real June 2026 export, the Point
327	   of Care gate produced EL=12 against the manual report's EL=627; removing
328	   it produces EL=626 (the 1-encounter gap left is a Shopper-mode encounter
329	   the tool deliberately excludes -- see Q4's sibling note and CLAUDE.md PART
330	   2.4). The NCID Point of Care list stays on the Config sheet but is now
331	   informational only.
332	
333	2. **FC Status priority order** (Section 2, step 3) -- is this the correct order of
334	   "best to worst" outcome for an FC?
335	
336	3. **Inflight duplicate-resolution rule** (Section 2, step 6) -- ~~when an
337	   encounter has multiple FC IDs and one was created by Inflight staff, should
338	   that one be set aside in favour of a non-Inflight FC ID (even if the
339	   Inflight one has a better status)?~~ **REVISED:** the exception is narrower
340	   -- it only applies when a non-Inflight ED/EDFC-created row is present AND
341	   the resulting winner has priority <= 2; otherwise the plain lowest-priority
342	   rule stands.
343	
344	4. **Voided/Deleted-only encounters** (Section 2, step 8) -- should these be fully
345	   excluded from the denominator (i.e. not counted as completed or missed at
346	   all)? **REOPENED 2026-07-30:** confirmed YES (exclude) on 2026-06-18, but
347	   this disagrees with actual practice -- the manual report for June 2026
348	   includes them (56 encounters: 8 EM + 48 EL). The tool currently counts them
349	   IN the denominator and IN "not completed" (their own Summary row) to match
350	   practice, but this is a practical workaround, not a resolved answer --
351	   please confirm which is actually correct: should these encounters be
352	   excluded from the completion percentage entirely, or counted as "not
353	   completed" like a Draft?
354	
355	5. **EDVW discharges** (Section 3, step 3) -- should these continue to count as
356	   missed FC like any other missed case (just flagged for visibility), with no
357	   exclusion?
358	
359	6. **Staff roster teams** (Section 4) -- are ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO,
360	   and Admin/Managers the correct full set of teams, with everyone else falling
361	   into "Others"?
362	
363	7. **Blank "Latest CCF Creation User" fallback** (Section 5B) -- for pure Draft FCs
364	   with no CCF ever generated, is it correct to fall back to "FC Created By" for the
365	   "who closed the CCF" breakdown (while still counting the encounter as Red/missed
366	   in the completion breakdown)?
367	
368	8. **Conservative principle** (Section 5) -- do you agree that ambiguous/edge cases
369	   should default to "not completed / missed" rather than "completed"?

# FC Completion Report -- Process Flow (For Review)

This document describes how the new FC Completion Report tool will process the
monthly eFC exports and calculate the completion statistics. Please read through
and confirm whether the rules below match how the report should actually work --
specific questions are listed at the end.

> **2026-07-29 conflict resolution note:** this document had silently diverged
> from "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" (the authoritative
> source) by the time Q1-Q8 below were confirmed on 2026-06-18. Two of those
> answers were revisited and revised against the guide: **Q1** (EM/EL split)
> now requires the Point of Care condition the guide always specified, and
> **Q3** (Inflight duplicate exception) was narrowed to match the guide's
> intent rather than the broader rule this document previously described. See
> the updated Section 2 steps 6 and 9, the priority table, and Section 5A
> below -- these now match the guide and the shipped code.
>
> **2026-07-30 reconciliation note:** the macro was validated against a real
> export (FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx, June 2026, 7,434 rows) and the
> team's manually produced report for the same month. Two more reversions
> came out of that reconciliation:
>
> - **Q1 (EM/EL split) reverted back to its ORIGINAL 2026-06-18 answer.** The
>   2026-07-29 Point of Care gate was tested against the real export and
>   produced EL=12 instead of the manual report's EL=627 -- the gate was
>   wrong. EM/EL is Admission Type alone again; the NCID Point of Care list is
>   now purely informational (an "NCID Ward" breakdown column, an "of which
>   NCID wards" summary sub-block, and a warning for unmatched "NCID" Point of
>   Care values) -- see the revised Section 2 step 9 and Section 6.
> - **Q4 (Voided/Deleted-only encounters) is REOPENED.** The manual report
>   includes them (56 this month: 8 EM + 48 EL); excluding them (the
>   2026-06-18 answer) disagreed with actual practice. The macro now counts
>   them IN the denominator and IN "not completed", with their own Summary
>   row -- see the revised Section 2 step 8 and Section 5A. This is NOT a
>   final answer, just practice winning over the original confirmation until
>   the team weighs in -- see Q4 in Section 7.
>
> Also added this run: a reconciliation waterfall on the Summary sheet (so
> the macro's math can be checked line-by-line against a manual count), a
> small-denominator guard (percentages suppressed under n=30), a roster
> coverage guard (warns/aborts before an empty or unmatched staff roster
> silently reports 100% "Others"), and roster bootstrap/export/import tools
> (`SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare`, `ExportStaffRoster`, `ImportStaffRoster`,
> all Alt+F8). See Section 4 and Section 6 below.

---

## 1. Inputs

Two eFC exports are used:

- **File A -- FC Summary Report**: one row per FC ID, full month, Admission Type
  Emergency (+ Elective Inpatient for NCID AO).
- **File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report** (OPTIONAL): Inflight FC Report with the
  "Missed FC" indicator ticked. If File B is not provided, the tool asks for a
  manual Missed FC count instead (the eFC dashboard workaround the guide
  documents), attributed entirely to Emergency (EM) since the dashboard
  workaround doesn't distinguish Elective/NCID AO missed cases.

---

## 2. File A -- Cleaning and Deduplication

The tool processes File A in this order:

1. **Remove non-FC rows.** Keep only rows where FC Mode is "Financial Counselling -
   AH" or "Financial Counselling - Downtime". (Removes Shopper-mode and other
   irrelevant rows.)

2. **Remove cancelled admissions.** Any row where Admission Status = "Cancelled" is
   dropped.

3. **Rank each remaining row by FC Status**, using this priority order (1 = best,
   higher number = worse):

   | Priority | FC Status |
   |---|---|
   | 1 | Completed |
   | 2 | Acknowledgement by other means |
   | 3 | Attempted - Virtual FC Completed, pending signature |
   | 4 | Attempted - patient/NOK declines to sign |
   | 5 | Attempted - Patient is unable to sign |
   | 6 | Attempted - unable to complete |
   | 98 | Anything else not explicitly listed above -- Draft variants, blanks, typos, new eFC statuses. Still IN the denominator (not completed), NOT excluded. |
   | 99 | Voided / Deleted ONLY (matched by substring, e.g. "Voided", "Deleted by Admin") -- excluded from the denominator entirely (see step 8). |

   The distinct FC Status text values landing on priority 98 are collected and
   printed as a warning block on the Summary sheet each run, so a typo or a
   brand-new eFC status is visible instead of silently shrinking the
   denominator.

4. **Group rows by Encounter Number** and sort each group so the most recently
   created CCF is last.

5. **Highlight duplicate encounter numbers in red** -- this is just a visual aid so
   staff can see at a glance which encounters had more than one FC ID.

6. **Pick one row to keep per encounter.** For each encounter with more than one FC
   ID:
   - The default rule is **plain lowest-priority-wins**: across ALL candidate rows,
     keep the one with the best (lowest) priority number from the table above. If
     there's a tie, keep the one with the **larger FC ID** (i.e. the more recently
     created one).
   - The **Inflight exception** only overrides this default when BOTH hold:
     a) at least one of the *non*-Inflight rows in the group was created by an
        **ED/EDFC** staff member (per the staff roster), AND
     b) the winner that would result from setting the Inflight row(s) aside has
        priority 1 or 2 (Completed / Acknowledgement by other means).
     When both hold, the Inflight-created row(s) are set aside and the winner is
     picked from the remaining non-Inflight candidates instead. If either
     condition fails, the plain lowest-priority rule from above stands -- the
     Inflight row is treated like any other candidate.
   - If an encounter only has one FC ID to begin with, that row is always kept
     (even if its priority is 99).
   - The tool counts how many encounter groups used the Inflight exception, and
     how many were blocked by the priority<=2 guard (fell back to the plain
     rule) -- both counts are reported in the final summary dialog and on the
     Methodology sheet.

7. **Delete every row that wasn't kept.** This replaces the old manual "review
   duplicates and delete" step entirely -- the tool does it automatically using the
   rule above.

8. **Encounters where the only surviving FC ID is Voided/Deleted (priority 99)**
   -- **REVISED 2026-07-30 (Q4 reopened):** these are now counted IN the
   denominator and IN "not completed", with their own "Voided/Deleted only"
   row on the Summary sheet (this matches the manual report -- 56 this month:
   8 EM + 48 EL -- but disagrees with the original 2026-06-18 answer, which
   excluded them entirely. See Q4 in Section 7.) The tool still reports the
   count separately so staff can double-check whether an FC is still needed
   for those encounters.

9. **Split the remaining rows into two sheets, based on Admission Type
   ALONE** -- **REVISED 2026-07-30 (Q1 reverted to its original 2026-06-18
   answer):**
   - **Emergency** admissions -> "EM" sheet.
   - **Elective Inpatient** admissions -> "EL" sheet. Every Elective Inpatient
     encounter goes to EL -- there is no Point of Care condition. (The
     2026-07-29 version gated EL on the Config "NCID EL Point of Care" list;
     tested against a real export it produced EL=12 against a manual count of
     627, so the gate has been removed.)
   - The NCID Point of Care list is still on the Config sheet, but is now
     purely informational: it drives an "NCID Ward" Yes/No column on the EL
     sheet and an "of which NCID wards" summary sub-block (so NCID AO's own
     subset of EL is still visible), plus a warning if any Point of Care value
     containing "NCID" isn't in the configured list (so a new ward is never
     silently missed).
   - Any row that is neither Emergency nor Elective Inpatient (shouldn't
     normally happen, given the export filters) is set aside and reported
     separately so nothing silently disappears.
   - As an extra check (informational only, doesn't change which sheet a row goes
     to), the tool flags rows where the bucket "looks wrong" -- e.g. an Emergency
     row that was actually closed by an NCID AO staff member, or an Elective row
     closed by ED/EDFC or Inflight staff. This is just a flag for staff to review.

---

## 3. File B -- Cleaning (Missed FC List) -- OPTIONAL

File B is now optional. If it isn't provided, the tool asks for a manual
Missed FC count (the eFC dashboard workaround) instead, and skips steps 1-3
below entirely -- everything after this section that reads "the missed FC
count" uses the manual entry, attributed to Emergency (EM), when File B is
absent.

1. **Keep only rows where "Missed FC" = Yes.**

2. **Remove Cancelled and Planned admissions** (Cancelled = upstream cancellation;
   Planned = patient never actually admitted).

3. **Flag EDVW discharges** (Point Of Care = "TTSH Virtual Ward" and Accommodation
   Code = "EDVW") with an informational column -- these are still counted as missed
   FC like everything else, just labelled so staff can see how many are EDVW cases.

4. **Everything left over = genuinely missed FC.** This becomes the follow-up list
   for EDFC/Inflight/NCID AO, and each row counts toward the "Missed FC" total.

---

## 4. Staff Roster and NCID Point of Care (Config)

Two independent editable lists live on the Config sheet:

- **Staff Name -> Team** -- where Team is one of: ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO,
  ICH PSO, Admin/Managers. Anyone not on the list is treated as "Others" (e.g.
  SOC staff). Used in three places:
  - Step 6 above (deciding which duplicate row to keep -- the Inflight exception).
  - The EM/EL "looks wrong" flag in Step 9 above.
  - The "who closed the CCF" percentage breakdown (Section 5 below).

- **NCID EL Point of Care** -- the exact Point of Care ward text values (NCID
  wards E and F). **REVISED 2026-07-30:** no longer gates the EL split (Step 9
  above) -- purely informational (the "NCID Ward" column/sub-block and the
  unmatched-value warning). Ships prefilled with the 10 confirmed ward values,
  still user-editable.

Because the staff roster gates team attribution, the Inflight duplicate
exception, and the "who closed the CCF" breakdown all at once, an empty or
badly-matched roster used to fail silently (everyone defaults to "Others",
and the report just shows 100% "Others" with no error). As of 2026-07-30 the
tool runs a **roster coverage guard** right after File A cleaning: it
measures what fraction of encounters map to a named team.
- **0% coverage:** asks whether to continue with completion statistics only
  (team attribution and the numerator table are suppressed entirely, not
  shown as rows of zeros) or abort.
- **Under 70%:** proceeds, but lists the unmatched staff names (biggest first)
  on the Summary sheet so you know which names to add.
- **70% or above:** proceeds silently; unmatched names are still listed on the
  Staff Roster Check sheet.

Three Alt+F8 tools help keep the roster populated and portable across the
report's monthly hand-off between team leads:
- **SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare** -- bootstraps a starting roster from an FC
  Summary Report export, guessing each staff member's team from their
  dominant Point of Care. Never overwrites a team you've already entered;
  low-confidence guesses (dominant Point of Care under 50%) are flagged.
- **ExportStaffRoster / ImportStaffRoster** -- round-trips the roster through
  a CSV file.

---

## 5. How the Numbers Are Calculated

**Denominator** (total encounters counted) = (unique encounters kept after
File A deduplication -- **including** Voided/Deleted-only, priority 99, as of
the 2026-07-30 Q4 reopening) + (genuinely missed FC count, from File B or
manual entry -- Section 3). The Summary sheet shows the full derivation as a
row-by-row reconciliation waterfall (rows loaded -> after FC Mode filter ->
after Cancelled filter -> unique encounters -> less duplicates -> encounters
carried forward -> plus missed FC -> = denominator), with a visible
balance-check row.

**A. Completion status breakdown** (counts and % of denominator) -- six bands,
plus a "Not completed (total)" subtotal so a single headline figure is still
available. Blocks with a denominator under 30 (e.g. the "of which NCID wards"
sub-block) show counts only -- percentages are suppressed as misleading at
that sample size.

| Colour | Meaning | Based on priority |
|---|---|---|
| Green | FC Completed with written acknowledgement | 1, 2 |
| Pink | CCF explained but not signed | 3 |
| Light Green | Attempted, no further follow-up | 4, 5 |
| Orange | FC not completed | 6 |
| White/none | Draft only -- no FC outcome | 98 |
| Voided/Deleted only (uncoloured) | Only surviving FC ID was Voided/Deleted (Q4 reopened, 2026-07-30) | 99 |
| Grey | Missed FC -- no FC ID created | File B / manual entry |

"Not completed (total)" = Orange + White/none + Voided/Deleted only + Grey.
Splitting Drafts (priority 98) and Voided/Deleted (priority 99) into their
own bands does not change this total or the overall completion percentage --
only the presentation. Each Summary block also shows a visible "Total" row so
a mismatch between the bands and the denominator would be obvious.

**B. Who closed the CCF** -- each File A encounter is categorized by the team of
whoever has "Latest CCF Creation User" (using the staff roster). If that field is
blank (i.e. no CCF was ever generated -- pure Draft), the tool falls back to "FC
Created By" instead, so the encounter is still credited to *some* team rather than
disappearing from this breakdown. File B's missed-FC count becomes its own "CCF not
generated" bucket.

**C. Numerator detail table** (counts used for team workload reporting):

| Metric | Based on | Team |
|---|---|---|
| FC completed by EDFC (initial) | FC Created By | ED/EDFC |
| FC completed by EDFC (full CCF) | Latest CCF Creation User | ED/EDFC |
| FC completed by Inflight | Latest CCF Creation User | Inflight |
| FC completed by NCID AO | Latest CCF Creation User | NCID AO |

**General principle:** when a case is ambiguous or borderline, the tool counts it as
**not completed / missed** rather than completed. The idea is that it's better to
slightly overstate outstanding work than to understate it.

All of A, B, and C above are calculated three times: once for Emergency, once for
Elective/NCID AO, and once combined.

---

## 6. What You'll Get (Output File)

A new Excel workbook with:

1. **EM sheet** -- cleaned, deduplicated Emergency encounters (one row per
   encounter). Always produced. Includes an informational "NCID Ward" column.
2. **EL sheet** -- same, for every Elective Inpatient encounter (Admission
   Type alone, no Point of Care gate as of 2026-07-30). Always produced.
   Includes an informational "NCID Ward" Yes/No column.
3. **Missed FC sheet** -- the follow-up list from File B. SKIPPED if File B
   was not provided (Section 3).
4. **Summary sheet** -- a reconciliation waterfall (Section 5), the
   colour-coded breakdown and % breakdowns for EM, EL, "of which NCID wards"
   (a subset of EL), and Combined, plus footnotes for anything excluded
   (Voided/Deleted-only encounters, unrecognised Admission Types, encounters
   lost entirely to the FC Mode filter, Missed FC source, Inflight exception
   counts), a warning block listing any genuinely unrecognised FC Status
   values seen (known "Draft" variants are excluded from this warning -- they
   are expected), a warning for any "NCID" Point of Care value not in the
   Config list, and -- if roster coverage is under 70% -- a list of unmatched
   staff names, biggest first.
5. **Methodology sheet** -- a plain-language explanation of exactly which rule
   counted each encounter as completed/missed, with the actual numbers for this
   month, so every figure can be traced back to a rule.
6. **Staff Roster Check sheet** -- roster entries not seen in this export, AND
   (2026-07-30) names seen in this export that didn't match any roster entry.

---

## 7. Please Confirm

> **Status (2026-07-29):** all eight questions below were originally confirmed
> 2026-06-18. Q1 and Q3 were subsequently revisited against "Guide to monthly
> processing of report 3.docx" (the authoritative source, which this document
> had silently diverged from) and revised -- see the note at the top of this
> document. Their answers below have been updated to match the guide and the
> shipped code; Q2, Q4-Q8 stand as originally confirmed (Q2's priority *table*
> was separately revised for Decision 2 -- see Section 2 above -- but the
> ranking order itself is unchanged).

1. **EM/EL split** -- is it correct that the only thing that decides whether
   an encounter goes into the EM (Emergency) or EL (Elective Inpatient) report
   is the **Admission Type** field, with no other conditions (e.g. ward/Point
   Of Care)? ~~**REVISED 2026-07-29:** no -- Elective Inpatient rows also
   require Point of Care to match the configured NCID ward E/F list (Section
   2, step 9).~~ **REVISED AGAIN 2026-07-30 -- back to YES, the original
   answer was correct.** Tested against the real June 2026 export, the Point
   of Care gate produced EL=12 against the manual report's EL=627; removing
   it produces EL=626 (the 1-encounter gap left is a Shopper-mode encounter
   the tool deliberately excludes -- see Q4's sibling note and CLAUDE.md PART
   2.4). The NCID Point of Care list stays on the Config sheet but is now
   informational only.

2. **FC Status priority order** (Section 2, step 3) -- is this the correct order of
   "best to worst" outcome for an FC?

3. **Inflight duplicate-resolution rule** (Section 2, step 6) -- ~~when an
   encounter has multiple FC IDs and one was created by Inflight staff, should
   that one be set aside in favour of a non-Inflight FC ID (even if the
   Inflight one has a better status)?~~ **REVISED:** the exception is narrower
   -- it only applies when a non-Inflight ED/EDFC-created row is present AND
   the resulting winner has priority <= 2; otherwise the plain lowest-priority
   rule stands.

4. **Voided/Deleted-only encounters** (Section 2, step 8) -- should these be fully
   excluded from the denominator (i.e. not counted as completed or missed at
   all)? **REOPENED 2026-07-30:** confirmed YES (exclude) on 2026-06-18, but
   this disagrees with actual practice -- the manual report for June 2026
   includes them (56 encounters: 8 EM + 48 EL). The tool currently counts them
   IN the denominator and IN "not completed" (their own Summary row) to match
   practice, but this is a practical workaround, not a resolved answer --
   please confirm which is actually correct: should these encounters be
   excluded from the completion percentage entirely, or counted as "not
   completed" like a Draft?

5. **EDVW discharges** (Section 3, step 3) -- should these continue to count as
   missed FC like any other missed case (just flagged for visibility), with no
   exclusion?

6. **Staff roster teams** (Section 4) -- are ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO,
   and Admin/Managers the correct full set of teams, with everyone else falling
   into "Others"?

7. **Blank "Latest CCF Creation User" fallback** (Section 5B) -- for pure Draft FCs
   with no CCF ever generated, is it correct to fall back to "FC Created By" for the
   "who closed the CCF" breakdown (while still counting the encounter as Red/missed
   in the completion breakdown)?

8. **Conservative principle** (Section 5) -- do you agree that ambiguous/edge cases
   should default to "not completed / missed" rather than "completed"?

Attribute VB_Name = "MainMacro"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' MainMacro.bas
'
' Entry point: GenerateFCCompletionReport (run via Alt+F8).
' Orchestrates the full pipeline:
'   1. FilePickerForm -- select File A (required) and File B (optional)
'   2. Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list from Config sheet
'   3. Clean File A (FC Mode filter, cancel filter, dedup), snapshotting row/
'      encounter counts along the way for the Summary sheet reconciliation
'      waterfall (PART 3.3, 2026-07-30)
'   4. Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) -- measures what fraction
'      of encounters map to a named team; warns or aborts before an empty/
'      unmatched roster silently reports 100% "Others"
'   5. Clean File B (FC Mode filter, Missed FC filter, cancel/planned, EDVW
'      flag) -- SKIPPED entirely if File B was not provided
'   6. Build output workbook (EM/EL split, Summary, Methodology, Roster Check)
'   7. Close input files, show success summary
'
' Step numbering is computed dynamically (stepNum/totalSteps) rather than
' hardcoded, so the progress bar adapts automatically to whether File B's
' four cleaning steps are present.
' ============================================================

Public Sub GenerateFCCompletionReport()

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    ' ---- Step 0: File picker ----
    Dim picker As FilePickerForm
    Set picker = New FilePickerForm
    If Not picker.ShowFilePicker Then Exit Sub

    Dim wbA As Workbook, wbB As Workbook
    Set wbA = picker.SelectedFileA
    Set wbB = picker.SelectedFileB

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (wbB Is Nothing)

    Dim wsA As Worksheet, wsB As Worksheet
    Set wsA = wbA.Sheets(1)
    If hasFileB Then Set wsB = wbB.Sheets(1)

    ' ---- Show progress (9 steps always + 4 more if File B is present) ----
    Dim totalSteps As Long
    totalSteps = 9
    If hasFileB Then totalSteps = totalSteps + 4
    ProgressForm.ShowProgress totalSteps

    Dim stepNum As Long
    stepNum = 0

    ' ---- Load staff roster + NCID EL Point of Care list ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Loading staff roster and NCID Point of Care list"
    Dim roster As Object
    Set roster = LoadStaffRoster()
    Dim ncidPocList As Object
    Set ncidPocList = LoadNCIDPointOfCareList()

    ' ---- Clean File A ----
    ' Waterfall snapshot: rows as loaded + distinct encounters before the FC
    ' Mode filter (PART 2.4 / 3.3, 2026-07-30).
    Dim rowsLoadedA As Long
    rowsLoadedA = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim encSetBeforeMode As Object
    Set encSetBeforeMode = GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA)
    Dim blankEncBeforeMode As Long
    blankEncBeforeMode = CountBlankEncounterRows(wsA)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- filtering FC Mode"
    If Not FilterFCMode(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    Dim rowsAfterMode As Long
    rowsAfterMode = CountDataRows(wsA)
    ' Encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter (PART 2.4): distinct
    ' real (non-blank) encounter numbers gone, PLUS at most 1 more if any
    ' blank-encounter row (e.g. a Shopper-mode form, which some eFC exports
    ' submit with no Encounter Number at all) was dropped -- a blank
    ' encounter number can't be split into separate real encounters, so all
    ' such rows lost this way count as one indeterminate "encounter", not one
    ' each.
    Dim encountersLostToModeFilter As Long
    encountersLostToModeFilter = CountKeysNotIn(encSetBeforeMode, GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA))
    If CountBlankEncounterRows(wsA) < blankEncBeforeMode Then
        encountersLostToModeFilter = encountersLostToModeFilter + 1
    End If

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- removing cancelled admissions"
    If Not DeleteCancelledAdmissions(wsA) Then GoTo Cleanup

    Dim rowsAfterCancelled As Long
    rowsAfterCancelled = CountDataRows(wsA)
    Dim uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup As Long
    uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup = GetDistinctEncounterSet(wsA).Count

    ' ---- Deduplicate File A ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- adding priority column"
    AddPriorityColumn wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- highlighting duplicate encounters"
    MarkDuplicateEncounters wsA

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File A -- resolving duplicates"
    Dim voidedOnlyCount As Long
    Dim dupGroupsResolved As Long
    Dim dupRowsRemoved As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionApplied As Long
    Dim inflightExceptionBlocked As Long
    If Not ResolveDuplicateEncounters(wsA, roster, voidedOnlyCount, _
            dupGroupsResolved, dupRowsRemoved, _
            inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked) Then GoTo Cleanup

    ' ---- Waterfall dictionary (PART 3.3) -- consumed by BuildOutput.bas's
    ' WriteReconciliationWaterfall on the Summary sheet.
    Dim waterfall As Object
    Set waterfall = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    waterfall("RowsLoaded") = rowsLoadedA
    waterfall("RowsAfterModeFilter") = rowsAfterMode
    waterfall("RowsAfterCancelledFilter") = rowsAfterCancelled
    waterfall("UniqueEncounters") = uniqueEncountersBeforeDedup
    waterfall("DuplicateGroupsResolved") = dupGroupsResolved
    waterfall("DuplicateRowsRemoved") = dupRowsRemoved
    waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter") = encountersLostToModeFilter

    ' ---- Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) ----
    ' Run after File A cleaning/dedup, before BuildOutputWorkbook, so an
    ' empty/unmatched roster is caught here rather than silently producing a
    ' Summary claiming 100% of CCFs were closed by "Others".
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Checking staff roster coverage"
    Dim unmatchedNames As Object
    Dim rosterCoverage As Double
    rosterCoverage = ComputeRosterCoverage(wsA, roster, unmatchedNames)

    Dim suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean
    suppressTeamBlocks = False

    If rosterCoverage = 0 Then
        Dim resp As VbMsgBoxResult
        resp = MsgBox("The staff roster (Config sheet) is empty, or doesn't match any names in " & _
            "this export." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "'Who Closed the CCF' and all four numerator indicators (FC created by EDFC, CCF " & _
            "closed by EDFC/Inflight/NCID AO) will be UNAVAILABLE for this report." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "Continue and produce completion statistics only?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, _
            "Staff Roster Not Matched")
        If resp = vbNo Then GoTo Cleanup
        suppressTeamBlocks = True
    ElseIf rosterCoverage < 0.7 Then
        MsgBox "Staff roster coverage is low: only " & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%") & _
            " of encounters matched a named team." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
            "The report will still be produced, but unmatched staff names will be listed on the " & _
            "Summary sheet (largest first) so you can see which names to add to the Config roster.", _
            vbInformation, "Low Roster Coverage"
    End If

    ' ---- Clean File B (skipped entirely if not provided) ----
    If hasFileB Then
        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- filtering FC Mode"
        If Not FilterFCModeIfPresent(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- keeping Missed FC rows"
        If Not KeepOnlyMissedFC(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- removing cancelled/planned"
        If Not DeleteCancelledOrPlanned(wsB) Then GoTo Cleanup

        stepNum = stepNum + 1
        ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "File B -- flagging EDVW discharges"
        FlagEDVWDischarges wsB
    End If

    ' ---- Build output ----
    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Building output workbook"
    Dim outputOK As Boolean
    outputOK = BuildOutputWorkbook(wsA, wsB, roster, ncidPocList, _
        picker.MissedFCManualCount, inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, _
        waterfall, rosterCoverage, unmatchedNames, suppressTeamBlocks)

    stepNum = stepNum + 1
    ProgressForm.Update stepNum, "Done"

    ' ---- Cleanup: close input files ----
    On Error Resume Next
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    On Error GoTo 0

    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False

    If outputOK Then
        Dim msg As String
        msg = "FC Completion Report generated successfully." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
              "Duplicate encounters resolved: " & dupGroupsResolved & _
              " (" & dupRowsRemoved & " row(s) removed)" & vbNewLine & _
              "Voided/Deleted-only encounters (counted in denominator, REVERT B): " & voidedOnlyCount & vbNewLine & _
              "Encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter (e.g. Shopper-only): " & _
              encountersLostToModeFilter & vbNewLine & _
              "Inflight duplicate exception applied: " & inflightExceptionApplied & _
              " group(s); blocked by the priority<=2 guard: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " group(s)"
        If suppressTeamBlocks Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "Staff roster coverage: 0% -- 'Who Closed the CCF' and numerator indicators were " & _
                  "suppressed this run."
        Else
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "Staff roster coverage: " & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%")
        End If
        If Not hasFileB Then
            msg = msg & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
                  "File B was not provided -- Missed FC count used manual entry: " & _
                  picker.MissedFCManualCount
        End If
        MsgBox msg, vbInformation, "Complete"
    Else
        MsgBox "Report generation encountered an error. Check the output workbook " & _
               "(if open) for partial results.", vbExclamation, "Warning"
    End If

    Exit Sub

Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    wbA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If hasFileB Then wbB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    Application.StatusBar = False
    On Error GoTo 0
    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:
    On Error Resume Next
    ProgressForm.CloseProgress
    Application.StatusBar = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    On Error GoTo 0
    MsgBox "Unexpected error:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
End Sub

Attribute VB_Name = "FilterFileA"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' FilterFileA.bas
'
' File A = FC Summary Report. This module covers the early cleaning
' steps that don't depend on the staff roster or any other file:
'
'   Step 1 -- FilterFCMode:     keep only Financial Counselling rows
'                                (drops Shopper mode and anything else)
'   Step 2 -- DeleteCancelledAdmissions: drop Admission Status = "Cancelled"
'
' Later steps (sort/highlight/dedup/EM-EL split) live in
' DeduplicateEncounters.bas and are orchestrated from MainMacro.
'
' Load-filter-write strategy: reads the sheet once into a Variant array,
' compacts matching rows in memory, writes back in one bulk operation.
' ============================================================

Private Const FC_MODE_AH       As String = "Financial Counselling - AH"
Private Const FC_MODE_DOWNTIME As String = "Financial Counselling - Downtime"

Private Const ADM_CANCELLED As String = "Cancelled"

' Step 1 -- keeps only rows where FC Mode is "Financial Counselling - AH" or
' "Financial Counselling - Downtime". Removes Shopper mode and any other
' non-FC mode rows.
Public Function FilterFCMode(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim modeCol As Long
    modeCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Mode")
    If modeCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing the 'FC Mode' column." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        FilterFCMode = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    FilterFCMode = True

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, modeCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    ' --- Step 1: Load entire working sheet into memory (one read) ---
    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ' --- Step 2: Count rows with an allowed FC Mode ---
    ' Both sides run through NormalizeDashesAndSpaces: the .docx guide writes
    ' "Financial Counselling - AH" with an EN DASH, so a real export using
    ' that character (or an em dash) must still match the plain-hyphen constants.
    Dim keepCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim modeVal As String
    Dim modeAHNorm As String, modeDowntimeNorm As String
    modeAHNorm = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(FC_MODE_AH))
    modeDowntimeNorm = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(FC_MODE_DOWNTIME))
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        modeVal = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(allData(i, modeCol))))
        If modeVal = modeAHNorm Or modeVal = modeDowntimeNorm Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = 0 Then
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).ClearContents
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        MsgBox "No Financial Counselling rows found after the FC Mode filter." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        FilterFCMode = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' --- Step 3: Build a compacted array of only the matching rows ---
    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        modeVal = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(allData(i, modeCol))))
        If modeVal = modeAHNorm Or modeVal = modeDowntimeNorm Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ' --- Step 4: Write filtered rows back starting at row 2 (one write) ---
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData

    ' --- Step 5: Delete the now-empty tail rows below the new last data row ---
    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "FC Mode filter complete: kept " & keepCount & " rows."
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during FC Mode filter:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    FilterFCMode = False

End Function

' Step 2 -- deletes rows where Admission Status = "Cancelled".
Public Function DeleteCancelledAdmissions(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim admStatCol As Long
    admStatCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Admission Status")
    If admStatCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing the 'Admission Status' column." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        DeleteCancelledAdmissions = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    DeleteCancelledAdmissions = True

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, admStatCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    ' --- Step 1: Load entire working sheet into memory (one read) ---
    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ' --- Step 2: Count rows whose Admission Status is NOT "Cancelled" ---
    Dim keepCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, admStatCol)))) <> UCase(ADM_CANCELLED) Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = lastRow - 1 Then
        ' Nothing to remove
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        Application.StatusBar = "Cancelled-admission filter complete: no Cancelled rows found."
        Exit Function
    End If

    If keepCount = 0 Then
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).ClearContents
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        MsgBox "All rows have Admission Status = 'Cancelled'." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        DeleteCancelledAdmissions = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' --- Step 3: Build a compacted array of only the non-Cancelled rows ---
    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, admStatCol)))) <> UCase(ADM_CANCELLED) Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ' --- Step 4: Write filtered rows back starting at row 2 (one write) ---
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData

    ' --- Step 5: Delete the now-empty tail rows below the new last data row ---
    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "Cancelled-admission filter complete: removed " & (lastRow - 1 - keepCount) & " row(s)."
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during Cancelled-admission filter:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    DeleteCancelledAdmissions = False

End Function

1	Attribute VB_Name = "DeduplicateEncounters"
2	Option Explicit
3	
4	' ============================================================
5	' DeduplicateEncounters.bas
6	'
7	' Implements Section 2 (steps 3-8) of
8	' docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md for File A
9	' (FC Summary Report), after FilterFileA's mode/cancellation cleaning:
10	'
11	'   GetFCStatusPriority   -- Step 3: priority order table (1 = best)
12	'   AddPriorityColumn     -- writes a "PRIORITISE" column using the table above
13	'   MarkDuplicateEncounters -- Step 5 (visual aid): highlight duplicate
14	'                              Encounter Numbers in red. Call this BEFORE
15	'                              ResolveDuplicateEncounters if you want a
16	'                              before-snapshot, since resolution deletes the
17	'                              losing rows.
18	'   ResolveDuplicateEncounters -- Steps 6-8: for each Encounter Number with
19	'                              more than one row, automatically picks the row
20	'                              to keep and deletes the rest. Also counts
21	'                              encounters whose only row is Voided/Deleted
22	'                              (priority 99) for the "please double-check"
23	'                              report -- these single rows are NOT deleted.
24	'
25	' Q2-Q4 from the process flow doc were confirmed 2026-06-18, then revised
26	' 2026-07-29 against "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" (the
27	' authoritative source, which the process flow doc had silently diverged
28	' from): priority 99 now means Voided/Deleted only (Decision 2), and the
29	' Inflight exception (Q3) was narrowed (Decision 4) -- it only overrides the
30	' plain "lowest priority wins" rule when a non-Inflight ED/EDFC-created row is
31	' in the group AND the resulting winner has priority <= 2. Driven by the
32	' Config "Staff Name -> Team" roster (Helpers.LoadStaffRoster) -- with an
33	' empty/unfilled roster everyone is "Others", so the exception never fires and
34	' the algorithm reduces to "lowest priority wins, tie-break by largest FC ID".
35	' ============================================================
36	
37	' ---- Step 3: FC Status priority order -----------------------------------------
38	'
39	' Lower number = better outcome = row to keep when an encounter has duplicates.
40	'
41	' Decision 2 (2026-07-29 conflict resolution): priority 99 is reserved for
42	' Voided/Deleted ONLY, matched via case-insensitive substring ("VOID" / "DELET")
43	' so wording variants (e.g. "Voided", "Deleted by Admin") are still caught.
44	' Everything else that isn't one of the six explicit statuses below -- Draft
45	' variants, blanks, typos, brand-new eFC statuses -- is priority 98 ("not
46	' completed" but NOT excluded from the denominator the way 99 is). Callers
47	' that need to surface unrecognised status text (for the Summary sheet warning
48	' block) should compare the input status against this function's Case list
49	' themselves; this function only returns the priority number.
50	Public Function GetFCStatusPriority(fcStatus As String) As Long
51	    Dim s As String
52	    s = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(fcStatus))
53	
54	    If InStr(s, "VOID") > 0 Or InStr(s, "DELET") > 0 Then
55	        GetFCStatusPriority = 99
56	        Exit Function
57	    End If
58	
59	    Select Case s
60	        Case "COMPLETED"
61	            GetFCStatusPriority = 1
62	        Case "ACKNOWLEDGEMENT BY OTHER MEANS"
63	            GetFCStatusPriority = 2
64	        Case "ATTEMPTED - VIRTUAL FC COMPLETED, PENDING SIGNATURE"
65	            GetFCStatusPriority = 3
66	        Case "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT/NOK DECLINES TO SIGN"
67	            GetFCStatusPriority = 4
68	        Case "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT IS UNABLE TO SIGN"
69	            GetFCStatusPriority = 5
70	        Case "ATTEMPTED - UNABLE TO COMPLETE"
71	            GetFCStatusPriority = 6
72	        Case Else
73	            GetFCStatusPriority = 98   ' Draft variants, blanks, typos, new statuses -- NOT excluded from denominator
74	    End Select
75	End Function

77	' Adds a "PRIORITISE" column as the last column, populated via
78	' GetFCStatusPriority for every data row. Lets staff see at a glance why the
79	' tool kept or dropped a given row.
80	Public Sub AddPriorityColumn(ws As Worksheet)
81	
82	    Dim fcStatusCol As Long
83	    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status")
84	    If fcStatusCol = 0 Then Exit Sub
85	
86	    Dim encCol As Long
87	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
88	
89	    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
90	    If encCol > 0 Then
91	        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
92	    Else
93	        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, fcStatusCol).End(xlUp).Row
94	    End If
95	    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
96	    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
97	
98	    Dim priCol As Long
99	    priCol = lastCol + 1
100	    ws.Cells(1, priCol).Value = "PRIORITISE"
101	
102	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
103	
104	    Dim statusData As Variant
105	    statusData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, fcStatusCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, fcStatusCol)).Value
106	
107	    Dim priData() As Variant
108	    ReDim priData(1 To lastRow - 1, 1 To 1)
109	
110	    Dim i As Long
111	    For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
112	        If lastRow = 2 Then
113	            priData(i, 1) = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(statusData))
114	        Else
115	            priData(i, 1) = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(statusData(i, 1)))
116	        End If

118	
119	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, priCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, priCol)).Value = priData
120
