Attribute VB_Name = "Helpers"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' Helpers.bas
'
' Shared utilities for the FC Completion Report macro:
'   - Column lookup by header (tolerant of wrapped/whitespace headers)
'   - Text normalisation (en/em dash variants -- see NormalizeDashesAndSpaces)
'   - Input file validation (FilePickerForm)
'   - Staff roster (Config sheet): Staff Name -> Team lookup
'   - NCID EL Point of Care list (Config sheet): informational NCID Ward
'     breakdown only (2026-07-30 -- no longer gates the EL sheet, see
'     BuildOutput.bas Revert A)
'   - Row/encounter-count snapshots for the Summary sheet reconciliation
'     waterfall (CountDataRows, GetDistinctEncounterSet, CountKeysNotIn)
'   - Roster coverage guard (ComputeRosterCoverage) -- run before
'     BuildOutputWorkbook so an empty/unmatched roster is caught, not
'     silently reported as 100% "Others"
'   - SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare -- Alt+F8 bootstrap that suggests a
'     Staff Name -> Team roster from an FC Summary Report export
'   - ExportStaffRoster / ImportStaffRoster -- CSV round trip so the roster
'     survives the report's monthly hand-off between team leads
'
' Team names used throughout the macro (DeduplicateEncounters, BuildOutput):
'   ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others
' "Others" is the default for any staff name not listed in the Config sheet,
' so the macro runs correctly even before the roster is filled in.
' ============================================================

Public Const TEAM_ED_EDFC As String = "ED/EDFC"
Public Const TEAM_INFLIGHT As String = "Inflight"
Public Const TEAM_NCID_AO As String = "NCID AO"
Public Const TEAM_ICH_PSO As String = "ICH PSO"
Public Const TEAM_ADMIN As String = "Admin/Managers"
Public Const TEAM_OTHERS As String = "Others"

' ---- Column lookup -----------------------------------------

' Searches row 1 of ws for a column whose header matches headerName.
' Matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant: line breaks
' (Alt+Enter / wrapped headers), non-breaking spaces, and runs of spaces
' are all normalised to a single space before comparison.
' Returns the 1-based column index, or 0 if not found.
Public Function FindColByHeader(ws As Worksheet, headerName As String) As Long
    Dim lastCol As Long
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim target As String
    target = NormHeader(headerName)

    Dim c As Long
    For c = 1 To lastCol
        If NormHeader(CStr(ws.Cells(1, c).Value)) = target Then
            FindColByHeader = c
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next c

    FindColByHeader = 0
End Function

' Normalises a header string for tolerant comparison:
'   - converts line breaks (Chr 10 / 13) and non-breaking spaces (Chr 160) to spaces
'   - collapses any run of spaces to a single space
'   - trims ends and upper-cases
Public Function NormHeader(s As String) As String
    Dim t As String
    t = CStr(s)
    t = Replace(t, Chr(10), " ")
    t = Replace(t, Chr(13), " ")
    t = Replace(t, Chr(160), " ")
    t = Replace(t, vbTab, " ")
    Do While InStr(t, "  ") > 0
        t = Replace(t, "  ", " ")
    Loop
    NormHeader = UCase(Trim(t))
End Function

' Encounter Number column is labelled differently across the two eFC exports:
'   - FC Summary Report (File A)         -> "Encounter Number"
'   - Inflight Missed FC Report (File B) -> "Encounter No"
' Try both spellings so the rest of the macro can use one column lookup.
Public Function FindEncounterCol(ws As Worksheet) As Long
    Dim col As Long
    col = FindColByHeader(ws, "Encounter Number")
    If col = 0 Then col = FindColByHeader(ws, "Encounter No")
    FindEncounterCol = col
End Function

' ---- Text normalisation (dash variants) -----------------------------------------

' The "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" writes FC Mode as
' "Financial Counselling - AH" using an EN DASH (both in prose and in its
' sample data table), not a plain hyphen. If a real eFC export also uses an
' en dash (or an em dash), a straight ASCII-hyphen comparison would delete
' every row and the user would see "No Financial Counselling rows found".
' Normalises en dash (Chr(150) -- Windows-1252 -- and ChrW(8211) -- Unicode)
' and em dash (ChrW(8212)) to a plain "-", then collapses runs of spaces and
' trims. Run BOTH sides of every FC Mode / FC Status comparison through this.
Public Function NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(s As String) As String
    Dim t As String
    t = CStr(s)
    t = Replace(t, Chr(150), "-")     ' Windows-1252 en dash
    t = Replace(t, ChrW(8211), "-")   ' Unicode en dash
    t = Replace(t, ChrW(8212), "-")   ' Unicode em dash
    Do While InStr(t, "  ") > 0
        t = Replace(t, "  ", " ")
    Loop
    NormalizeDashesAndSpaces = Trim(t)
End Function

' ---- File validation (used by FilePickerForm) -----------------------------------------

' Validates that wb's first sheet has the critical columns for fileType.
'   "FC_SUMMARY"      -- File A, FC Summary Report
'   "INFLIGHT_MISSED" -- File B, Inflight Missed FC Report (Missed FC ticked)
Public Function ValidateFileHeaders(wb As Workbook, fileType As String) As Boolean
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(1)

    Dim isValid As Boolean
    isValid = False

    Select Case UCase(fileType)
        Case "FC_SUMMARY"
            ' Critical columns per CLAUDE.md: FC ID, Encounter Number, FC Status, FC Mode
            If FindColByHeader(ws, "FC ID") > 0 And _
               FindEncounterCol(ws) > 0 And _
               FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status") > 0 And _
               FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Mode") > 0 Then
                isValid = True
            End If

        Case "INFLIGHT_MISSED"
            ' Critical columns per CLAUDE.md: Encounter No, Missed FC, Admission Status
            If FindEncounterCol(ws) > 0 And _
               FindColByHeader(ws, "Missed FC") > 0 And _
               FindColByHeader(ws, "Admission Status") > 0 Then
                isValid = True
            End If
    End Select

    ValidateFileHeaders = isValid
End Function

' Returns True if File B's "Missed FC" column exists but is entirely blank --
' i.e. the export was taken without ticking the "Missed FC" indicator.
' FilePickerForm uses this to warn the user to re-export with the indicator
' ticked, or use the manual eFC dashboard workaround export (CLAUDE.md).
Public Function IsMissedFCColumnBlank(wb As Workbook) As Boolean
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(1)

    Dim missedCol As Long
    missedCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Missed FC")
    If missedCol = 0 Then
        IsMissedFCColumnBlank = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        IsMissedFCColumnBlank = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        IsMissedFCColumnBlank = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim data As Variant
    data = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, missedCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, missedCol)).Value

    Dim i As Long
    If lastRow = 2 Then
        ' Single-cell range comes back as a scalar, not a 2-D array
        IsMissedFCColumnBlank = (Trim(CStr(data)) = "")
        Exit Function
    End If

    For i = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
        If Trim(CStr(data(i, 1))) <> "" Then
            IsMissedFCColumnBlank = False
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i

    IsMissedFCColumnBlank = True
End Function

' ---- Staff roster (Config sheet) -----------------------------------------

' Creates the Config worksheet in this workbook if it does not already exist.
' Run this once via Alt+F8 before using GenerateFCCompletionReport for the first time.
' After running, go to the Config tab and replace the placeholder staff names
' with your team's actual names and teams.
Public Sub CreateConfigSheet()
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0

    If Not ws Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Config sheet already exists. Edit it directly to update the staff roster.", _
               vbInformation, "Config"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))
    ws.Name = "Config"

    ' Column A header -- Staff Name
    With ws.Cells(1, 1)
        .Value = "Staff Name"
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 73, 125)
        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With

    ' Column B header -- Team
    With ws.Cells(1, 2)
        .Value = "Team"
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 73, 125)
        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With

    ' Column D header -- NCID EL Point of Care (list is separate from the
    ' Staff Name/Team table so it can grow independently; column C is left
    ' blank as a visual spacer).
    With ws.Cells(1, 4)
        .Value = "NCID EL Point of Care"
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 73, 125)
        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With

    ' Tooltip-style comments on the headers guide users without cluttering the sheet
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Cells(1, 1).Comment.Delete
    ws.Cells(1, 2).Comment.Delete
    ws.Cells(1, 4).Comment.Delete
    ws.Cells(1, 1).AddComment "Edit the list below -- one staff member per row, exactly as " & _
                               "their name appears in the eFC 'FC Created By' / " & _
                               "'Latest CCF Creation User' columns." & vbNewLine & _
                               "Do not rename or delete this header."
    ws.Cells(1, 2).AddComment "Pick a team from the dropdown for each staff member." & vbNewLine & _
                               "Anyone left off this list is treated as '" & TEAM_OTHERS & "'." & vbNewLine & _
                               "Do not rename or delete this header."
    ws.Cells(1, 4).AddComment "Prefilled with the 10 confirmed NCID ward Point of Care text " & _
                               "values -- edit/add/remove rows as new wards are confirmed." & vbNewLine & _
                               "This list is NOT a gate on the EL sheet -- EL (Elective " & _
                               "Inpatient) is every Elective Inpatient encounter, regardless of " & _
                               "Point of Care. This list only drives the informational 'NCID " & _
                               "Ward' breakdown and the unmatched-NCID-ward warning." & vbNewLine & _
                               "Do not rename or delete this header."
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' Placeholder roster -- update with real names/teams after running this sub
    ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = "Staff A"
    ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = TEAM_ED_EDFC
    ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = "Staff B"
    ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = TEAM_INFLIGHT
    ws.Cells(4, 1).Value = "Staff C"
    ws.Cells(4, 2).Value = TEAM_NCID_AO

    ' NCID EL Point of Care list -- prefilled with the 10 confirmed ward values
    ' (still user-editable; add/remove rows as new wards are confirmed).
    Dim ncidWards As Variant
    ncidWards = Array( _
        "TTSH NCID WARD 3E ICU", _
        "TTSH NCID WARD 6F (ISO)", _
        "TTSH NCID WARD 7E (NEP)", _
        "TTSH NCID WARD 7F (ISO)", _
        "TTSH NCID WARD 8E (NEP)", _
        "TTSH NCID WARD 8F (ISO)", _
        "TTSH NCID WARD 11E (NEP)", _
        "TTSH NCID WARD 11F (COHORT)", _
        "TTSH NCID WARD 12E (COHORT)", _
        "TTSH NCID WARD 14F (COHORT)")
    Dim wIdx As Long
    For wIdx = LBound(ncidWards) To UBound(ncidWards)
        ws.Cells(2 + wIdx, 4).Value = ncidWards(wIdx)
    Next wIdx

    ' Dropdown validation on the Team column for the placeholder rows and a
    ' generous block below them, so staff can keep adding names.
    Dim teamList As String
    teamList = TEAM_ED_EDFC & "," & TEAM_INFLIGHT & "," & TEAM_NCID_AO & "," & _
               TEAM_ICH_PSO & "," & TEAM_ADMIN & "," & TEAM_OTHERS

    With ws.Range("B2:B500").Validation
        .Delete
        .Add Type:=xlValidateList, AlertStyle:=xlValidAlertStop, Formula1:=teamList
        .IgnoreBlank = True
        .InCellDropdown = True
    End With

    ws.Columns("A:B").AutoFit
    ws.Columns("D:D").ColumnWidth = 30

    MsgBox "Config sheet created." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
           "Next step: go to the 'Config' tab and replace the placeholder staff " & _
           "names with your team's actual names, and set each person's Team " & _
           "from the dropdown." & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
           "Column D (NCID EL Point of Care) is prefilled with the 10 confirmed ward " & _
           "values -- edit as needed. It does not gate the EL sheet; it only drives " & _
           "the informational NCID Ward breakdown.", _
           vbInformation, "Config Created"

End Sub

' Loads the "NCID EL Point of Care" list (Config sheet, column D) into a
' Dictionary (keys are Point of Care text values, case-insensitive; values
' unused). Returns an empty Dictionary if the Config sheet or column doesn't
' exist yet, or if the list hasn't been filled in.
'
' REVERT A (2026-07-30): this list is no longer a gate on the EL sheet -- EL is
' every Elective Inpatient encounter regardless of Point of Care (Q1's original
' answer). The list is still used for the informational "NCID Ward" breakdown
' on the EL sheet/summary and to warn if a Point of Care value containing
' "NCID" isn't in this list (PART 3 of the 2026-07-30 change set).
Public Function LoadNCIDPointOfCareList() As Object
    Dim list As Object
    Set list = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    list.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set LoadNCIDPointOfCareList = list
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim pocCol As Long
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "NCID EL Point of Care")
    If pocCol = 0 Then
        Set LoadNCIDPointOfCareList = list
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, pocCol).End(xlUp).Row

    Dim i As Long, v As String
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        v = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(i, pocCol).Value))
        If v <> "" Then list(v) = True
    Next i

    Set LoadNCIDPointOfCareList = list
End Function

' Loads the Staff Name -> Team roster from the Config sheet into a Dictionary
' (keys are staff names, case-insensitive). Returns an empty Dictionary if the
' Config sheet doesn't exist yet or is missing its headers -- GetStaffTeam then
' defaults everyone to "Others", so the macro still runs correctly before the
' roster is filled in.
Public Function LoadStaffRoster() As Object
    Dim roster As Object
    Set roster = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    roster.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set LoadStaffRoster = roster
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim nameCol As Long, teamCol As Long
    nameCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Staff Name")
    teamCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Team")
    If nameCol = 0 Or teamCol = 0 Then
        Set LoadStaffRoster = roster
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, nameCol).End(xlUp).Row

    Dim i As Long
    Dim nm As String, tm As String
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        ' Run the roster key through NormalizeDashesAndSpaces (4.2, 2026-07-30):
        ' real eFC names carry stray double spaces / trailing whitespace, and a
        ' raw Trim() alone was letting those silently fall through to "Others".
        nm = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(ws.Cells(i, nameCol).Value))
        tm = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(i, teamCol).Value))
        If nm <> "" And tm <> "" Then roster(nm) = tm
    Next i

    Set LoadStaffRoster = roster
End Function

' Returns the team for a given staff name, looked up from the roster Dictionary
' returned by LoadStaffRoster. Defaults to "Others" if the name is blank, not
' found in the roster, or the roster is empty.
'
' Both the roster keys (LoadStaffRoster) and the lookup name here are run
' through NormalizeDashesAndSpaces before comparing (4.2, 2026-07-30) -- the
' roster.CompareMode = vbTextCompare already handles case, but not doubled/
' trailing whitespace, which real eFC display names do contain.
Public Function GetStaffTeam(roster As Object, staffName As String) As String
    Dim nm As String
    nm = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(staffName)

    If nm = "" Then
        GetStaffTeam = TEAM_OTHERS
    ElseIf roster.Exists(nm) Then
        GetStaffTeam = CStr(roster(nm))
    Else
        GetStaffTeam = TEAM_OTHERS
    End If
End Function

' ---- Reconciliation waterfall helpers (PART 3.3, 2026-07-30) --------------

' Number of data rows currently on ws (0 if the Encounter column is missing
' or the sheet has no data rows). Used by MainMacro to snapshot row counts
' before/after each File A cleaning step for the Summary sheet waterfall.
Public Function CountDataRows(ws As Worksheet) As Long
    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        CountDataRows = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        CountDataRows = 0
    Else
        CountDataRows = lastRow - 1
    End If
End Function

' Distinct Encounter Number values currently on ws, as a Dictionary (keys are
' encounter numbers, vbTextCompare; values unused). Used by MainMacro to
' measure how many distinct encounters vanish entirely across a filtering
' step (e.g. the Shopper-only encounters lost to the FC Mode filter, PART 2.4).
Public Function GetDistinctEncounterSet(ws As Worksheet) As Object
    Dim result As Object
    Set result = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    result.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        Set GetDistinctEncounterSet = result
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        Set GetDistinctEncounterSet = result
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim data As Variant
    data = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, encCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, encCol)).Value

    Dim i As Long, key As String
    If lastRow = 2 Then
        key = Trim(CStr(data))
        If key <> "" Then result(key) = True
    Else
        For i = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
            key = Trim(CStr(data(i, 1)))
            If key <> "" Then result(key) = True
        Next i
    End If

    Set GetDistinctEncounterSet = result
End Function

' Count of keys in setA that are NOT present in setB -- used to measure
' encounters lost entirely across a filtering step (PART 2.4 / PART 3.3).
' NOTE: GetDistinctEncounterSet skips blank Encounter Number values, so a row
' with a blank encounter number is invisible to this diff -- see
' CountBlankEncounterRows for why that matters for the FC Mode filter.
Public Function CountKeysNotIn(setA As Object, setB As Object) As Long
    Dim n As Long
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In setA.Keys
        If Not setB.Exists(CStr(k)) Then n = n + 1
    Next k
    CountKeysNotIn = n
End Function

' Number of data rows on ws whose Encounter Number is blank. Real eFC exports
' have at least one FC Mode (e.g. Shopper) that is submitted with NO
' Encounter Number at all -- such rows are invisible to
' GetDistinctEncounterSet/CountKeysNotIn (which key on Encounter Number), so
' MainMacro uses this alongside that diff to detect "the FC Mode filter
' dropped a blank-encounter row" without overcounting: since a blank
' encounter number can't be disambiguated into separate real encounters, all
' such rows lost to a filter are counted as at most ONE "encounter" (see
' MainMacro's encountersLostToModeFilter calculation, PART 2.4/3.3).
Public Function CountBlankEncounterRows(ws As Worksheet) As Long
    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        CountBlankEncounterRows = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        CountBlankEncounterRows = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim data As Variant
    data = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, encCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, encCol)).Value

    Dim i As Long, n As Long
    If lastRow = 2 Then
        If Trim(CStr(data)) = "" Then n = 1
    Else
        For i = 1 To UBound(data, 1)
            If Trim(CStr(data(i, 1))) = "" Then n = n + 1
        Next i
    End If

    CountBlankEncounterRows = n
End Function

' ---- Roster coverage guard (PART 4.1, 2026-07-30) --------------------------

' Measures the fraction of File A encounters (post-cleaning, pre-dedup or
' post-dedup -- either works, since dedup keeps exactly one row per encounter)
' whose resolved CCF closer (Latest CCF Creation User, falling back to FC
' Created By per Q7) maps to a NAMED team rather than "Others". Call this
' after File A cleaning/dedup and before BuildOutputWorkbook so MainMacro can
' warn the user (or offer to abort) before an empty/unmatched roster silently
' produces a Summary claiming 100% of CCFs were closed by "Others".
'
' unmatchedNames is filled with distinct unmatched resolved-closer names ->
' row count, descending-sortable via SortDictKeysDescending.
Public Function ComputeRosterCoverage(fileAws As Worksheet, roster As Object, _
        ByRef unmatchedNames As Object) As Double

    Set unmatchedNames = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unmatchedNames.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim encCol As Long, createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")

    If encCol = 0 Then
        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim cbData As Variant, lcData As Variant
    If createdByCol > 0 Then cbData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, createdByCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
    If latestCCFCol > 0 Then lcData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value

    Dim total As Long, matched As Long
    Dim i As Long, nm As String, cbNm As String, lcNm As String

    For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
        If createdByCol > 0 Then
            If lastRow = 2 Then cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData)) Else cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData(i, 1)))
        Else
            cbNm = ""
        End If
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
            If lastRow = 2 Then lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData)) Else lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData(i, 1)))
        Else
            lcNm = ""
        End If

        If lcNm <> "" Then
            nm = lcNm
        ElseIf cbNm <> "" Then
            nm = cbNm
        Else
            nm = ""
        End If

        total = total + 1
        If nm <> "" Then
            If GetStaffTeam(roster, nm) <> TEAM_OTHERS Then
                matched = matched + 1
            Else
                Dim normNm As String
                normNm = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(nm)
                If unmatchedNames.Exists(normNm) Then
                    unmatchedNames(normNm) = unmatchedNames(normNm) + 1
                Else
                    unmatchedNames(normNm) = 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If total = 0 Then
        ComputeRosterCoverage = 0
    Else
        ComputeRosterCoverage = matched / total
    End If
End Function

' Returns the keys of a Dictionary(String -> Long) sorted by value descending,
' as a String array. Used everywhere an unmatched-name or suggestion list
' needs to show the biggest-impact entries first. VBA has no built-in sort,
' hence the manual insertion sort -- fine at the scale of a few hundred names.
Public Function SortDictKeysDescending(d As Object) As Variant
    Dim n As Long
    n = d.Count
    If n = 0 Then
        SortDictKeysDescending = Array()
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim keys() As String, counts() As Long
    ReDim keys(1 To n)
    ReDim counts(1 To n)

    Dim k As Variant, idx As Long
    idx = 0
    For Each k In d.Keys
        idx = idx + 1
        keys(idx) = CStr(k)
        counts(idx) = CLng(d(k))
    Next k

    Dim a As Long, b As Long, tmpS As String, tmpL As Long
    For a = 2 To n
        tmpS = keys(a): tmpL = counts(a)
        b = a - 1
        ' VBA's And is NOT short-circuit: "b >= 1 And counts(b) < tmpL" still
        ' evaluates counts(0) once b reaches 0, which is out of bounds for a
        ' 1-based array -- run-time error 9. Test the bound separately.
        Do While b >= 1
            If counts(b) >= tmpL Then Exit Do
            keys(b + 1) = keys(b)
            counts(b + 1) = counts(b)
            b = b - 1
        Loop
        keys(b + 1) = tmpS
        counts(b + 1) = tmpL
    Next a

    SortDictKeysDescending = keys
End Function

' ---- SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare bootstrap (PART 4.3, 2026-07-30) ----------

' One-off bootstrap so a blank Config roster is never faced cold. Run via
' Alt+F8. Prompts for an FC Summary Report export, tallies Point Of Care per
' staff name (across BOTH "FC Created By" and "Latest CCF Creation User"),
' and writes suggestions to the Config sheet:
'   - A reference table in columns F:K (Staff Name | Rows | Dominant Point Of
'     Care | % Dominant | Suggested Team | Confidence), sorted by Rows
'     descending.
'   - Fills the main roster's Team column (B) ONLY where it is currently
'     blank -- an existing non-blank Team is NEVER overwritten. Staff names
'     not yet in the roster at all are appended as new rows with the
'     suggested team.
' Suggestions are a STARTING POINT only -- the team leads' own staff lists
' are authoritative.
Public Sub SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare()
    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFilePicker)
    fd.title = "Select FC Summary Report export for team suggestions"
    fd.Filters.Clear
    fd.Filters.Add "Excel Files", "*.xlsx; *.xlsm; *.xls"
    If fd.Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(fd.SelectedItems(1))
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(1)

    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long, pocCol As Long, encCol As Long
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Point of Care")
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    If pocCol = 0 Or (createdByCol = 0 And latestCCFCol = 0) Then
        MsgBox "Cannot suggest teams: this export is missing 'Point of Care' and/or both " & _
            "'FC Created By' / 'Latest CCF Creation User' columns.", vbExclamation, "Missing Columns"
        wb.Close SaveChanges:=False
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, pocCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If

    ' nameData(staffName) = Dictionary of pocValue -> count
    Dim nameData As Object
    Set nameData = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    nameData.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim i As Long
    Dim cbNm As String, lcNm As String, pocVal As String

    If lastRow >= 2 Then
        Dim cbData As Variant, lcData As Variant, pocData As Variant
        If createdByCol > 0 Then cbData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, createdByCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, createdByCol)).Value
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then lcData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, latestCCFCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, latestCCFCol)).Value
        pocData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, pocCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, pocCol)).Value

        For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
            If lastRow = 2 Then
                pocVal = Trim(CStr(pocData))
            Else
                pocVal = Trim(CStr(pocData(i, 1)))
            End If

            If createdByCol > 0 Then
                If lastRow = 2 Then cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData)) Else cbNm = Trim(CStr(cbData(i, 1)))
                If cbNm <> "" Then TallyStaffPOC nameData, cbNm, pocVal
            End If
            If latestCCFCol > 0 Then
                If lastRow = 2 Then lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData)) Else lcNm = Trim(CStr(lcData(i, 1)))
                If lcNm <> "" Then TallyStaffPOC nameData, lcNm, pocVal
            End If
        Next i
    End If

    wb.Close SaveChanges:=False

    If nameData.Count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "No staff names found in the export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim cfg As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set cfg = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If cfg Is Nothing Then
        CreateConfigSheet
        Set cfg = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    End If

    ' Existing roster rows (normalised name -> row number), so suggestions
    ' merge into the roster instead of duplicating rows.
    Dim existingRow As Object
    Set existingRow = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    existingRow.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    Dim lastRosterRow As Long
    lastRosterRow = cfg.Cells(cfg.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    Dim r As Long, en As String
    For r = 2 To lastRosterRow
        en = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(cfg.Cells(r, 1).Value))
        If en <> "" Then existingRow(en) = r
    Next r

    ' Suggestion reference table headers (columns F:K)
    cfg.Cells(1, 6).Value = "Staff Name"
    cfg.Cells(1, 7).Value = "Rows"
    cfg.Cells(1, 8).Value = "Dominant Point Of Care"
    cfg.Cells(1, 9).Value = "% Dominant"
    cfg.Cells(1, 10).Value = "Suggested Team"
    cfg.Cells(1, 11).Value = "Confidence"
    With cfg.Range(cfg.Cells(1, 6), cfg.Cells(1, 11))
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 73, 125)
        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    On Error Resume Next
    cfg.Cells(1, 6).Comment.Delete
    On Error GoTo 0
    cfg.Cells(1, 6).AddComment "Suggestions from SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare (Alt+F8) -- a " & _
        "STARTING POINT only. Your team leads' own staff lists are authoritative -- always " & _
        "confirm before relying on these, especially anything flagged 'LOW -- please confirm'."

    Dim namesSorted As Variant
    namesSorted = SortDictKeysDescending(RowCountsFromNameData(nameData))

    Dim suggestedCounts As Object
    Set suggestedCounts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Dim lowCount As Long

    Dim outRow As Long
    outRow = 2
    Dim idx As Long
    For idx = LBound(namesSorted) To UBound(namesSorted)
        Dim staffName As String
        staffName = CStr(namesSorted(idx))
        Dim pocDict As Object
        Set pocDict = nameData(staffName)

        Dim domPoc As String, domCount As Long, totalCount As Long
        DominantPOC pocDict, domPoc, domCount, totalCount

        Dim pctDom As Double
        If totalCount > 0 Then pctDom = domCount / totalCount Else pctDom = 0

        Dim suggestedTeam As String
        suggestedTeam = SuggestTeamFromPOC(domPoc)

        Dim confidence As String
        If pctDom < 0.5 Then
            confidence = "LOW -- please confirm"
            lowCount = lowCount + 1
        Else
            confidence = "OK"
        End If

        cfg.Cells(outRow, 6).Value = staffName
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 7).Value = totalCount
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 8).Value = domPoc
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 9).Value = pctDom
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 9).NumberFormat = "0%"
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 10).Value = suggestedTeam
        cfg.Cells(outRow, 11).Value = confidence

        If suggestedCounts.Exists(suggestedTeam) Then
            suggestedCounts(suggestedTeam) = suggestedCounts(suggestedTeam) + 1
        Else
            suggestedCounts(suggestedTeam) = 1
        End If

        ' Fill roster Team column only if blank -- never overwrite an existing team.
        Dim normStaffName As String
        normStaffName = NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(staffName)
        If existingRow.Exists(normStaffName) Then
            Dim rr As Long
            rr = existingRow(normStaffName)
            If Trim(CStr(cfg.Cells(rr, 2).Value)) = "" Then
                cfg.Cells(rr, 2).Value = suggestedTeam
            End If
        Else
            lastRosterRow = lastRosterRow + 1
            cfg.Cells(lastRosterRow, 1).Value = staffName
            cfg.Cells(lastRosterRow, 2).Value = suggestedTeam
            existingRow(normStaffName) = lastRosterRow
        End If

        outRow = outRow + 1
    Next idx

    cfg.Columns("A:K").AutoFit

    Dim summaryMsg As String
    summaryMsg = (UBound(namesSorted) - LBound(namesSorted) + 1) & " staff name(s) analysed." & vbNewLine
    Dim tk As Variant
    For Each tk In suggestedCounts.Keys
        summaryMsg = summaryMsg & "  " & CStr(tk) & ": " & suggestedCounts(tk) & vbNewLine
    Next tk
    summaryMsg = summaryMsg & vbNewLine & lowCount & " name(s) flagged LOW -- please confirm."

    MsgBox summaryMsg, vbInformation, "Team Suggestions Complete"
End Sub

' Builds a Dictionary(staffName -> total row count) from the nameData
' structure (staffName -> Dictionary(pocValue -> count)), for SortDictKeysDescending.
Private Function RowCountsFromNameData(nameData As Object) As Object
    Dim result As Object
    Set result = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    result.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In nameData.Keys
        result(CStr(k)) = SumDict(nameData(CStr(k)))
    Next k
    Set RowCountsFromNameData = result
End Function

Private Sub TallyStaffPOC(nameData As Object, staffName As String, pocVal As String)
    If Not nameData.Exists(staffName) Then
        Dim d As Object
        Set d = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        d.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
        nameData.Add staffName, d
    End If
    Dim pd As Object
    Set pd = nameData(staffName)
    Dim key As String
    key = pocVal
    If key = "" Then key = "(blank)"
    If pd.Exists(key) Then
        pd(key) = pd(key) + 1
    Else
        pd(key) = 1
    End If
End Sub

Private Function SumDict(d As Object) As Long
    Dim total As Long
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In d.Keys
        total = total + d(k)
    Next k
    SumDict = total
End Function

Private Sub DominantPOC(pocDict As Object, ByRef domPoc As String, ByRef domCount As Long, ByRef totalCount As Long)
    domPoc = ""
    domCount = 0
    totalCount = 0
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In pocDict.Keys
        totalCount = totalCount + pocDict(k)
        If pocDict(k) > domCount Then
            domCount = pocDict(k)
            domPoc = CStr(k)
        End If
    Next k
End Function

Private Function SuggestTeamFromPOC(pocVal As String) As String
    Dim u As String
    u = UCase(Trim(pocVal))

    If u = "TTSH EMERGENCY" Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_ED_EDFC
    ElseIf u = "TTSH VIRTUAL WARD" Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_INFLIGHT
    ElseIf Left(u, Len("TTSH@HOME")) = "TTSH@HOME" Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_INFLIGHT
    ElseIf InStr(u, "NCID") > 0 Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_NCID_AO
    ElseIf Left(u, Len("ICH WARD")) = "ICH WARD" Then
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_ICH_PSO
    Else
        SuggestTeamFromPOC = TEAM_OTHERS
    End If
End Function

' ---- Roster export / import (PART 4.4, 2026-07-30) -------------------------

' Writes the Config sheet's Staff Name / Team roster to a CSV via a SaveAs
' dialog, so the monthly-rotating report can carry one team's roster into
' the next lead's workbook copy without them drifting apart.
Public Sub ExportStaffRoster()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Config sheet does not exist yet. Run CreateConfigSheet (Alt+F8) first.", _
               vbExclamation, "No Config Sheet"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim nameCol As Long, teamCol As Long
    nameCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Staff Name")
    teamCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Team")
    If nameCol = 0 Or teamCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Config sheet is missing the 'Staff Name' / 'Team' headers.", vbExclamation, "Missing Columns"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, nameCol).End(xlUp).Row

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)
    fd.title = "Export Staff Roster"
    fd.InitialFileName = "FC_Staff_Roster.csv"
    If fd.Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim savePath As String
    savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)

    Dim fnum As Integer
    fnum = FreeFile
    Open savePath For Output As #fnum

    Print #fnum, "Staff Name,Team"

    Dim r As Long, nm As String, tm As String, count As Long
    For r = 2 To lastRow
        nm = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(r, nameCol).Value))
        tm = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(r, teamCol).Value))
        If nm <> "" Then
            Print #fnum, CSVQuote(nm) & "," & CSVQuote(tm)
            count = count + 1
        End If
    Next r

    Close #fnum

    Dim plural As String
    If count = 1 Then plural = "y" Else plural = "ies"
    MsgBox count & " staff roster entr" & plural & " exported to:" & vbNewLine & savePath, _
           vbInformation, "Export Complete"
End Sub

' Reads a Staff Name,Team CSV (as written by ExportStaffRoster) via an Open
' dialog, confirms with the user, then REPLACES the current Config roster.
' Quoted fields (e.g. "LIM YONG CHIEW, DESMOND") are parsed correctly.
Public Sub ImportStaffRoster()
    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFilePicker)
    fd.title = "Import Staff Roster"
    fd.Filters.Clear
    fd.Filters.Add "CSV Files", "*.csv"
    If fd.Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim filePath As String
    filePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)

    Dim fnum As Integer
    fnum = FreeFile
    Open filePath For Input As #fnum

    Dim lines As New Collection
    Dim ln As String
    Do While Not EOF(fnum)
        Line Input #fnum, ln
        lines.Add ln
    Loop
    Close #fnum

    If lines.Count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "The selected file is empty.", vbExclamation, "Empty File"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim resp As VbMsgBoxResult
    resp = MsgBox("This will REPLACE the current staff roster on the Config sheet with up to " & _
        (lines.Count - 1) & " row(s) from:" & vbNewLine & filePath & vbNewLine & vbNewLine & _
        "Continue?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion, "Confirm Roster Import")
    If resp = vbNo Then Exit Sub

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        CreateConfigSheet
        Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Config")
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow >= 2 Then ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, 2)).ClearContents

    Dim i As Long, outRow As Long, loaded As Long, malformed As Long
    outRow = 2
    For i = 1 To lines.Count
        Dim rawLine As String
        rawLine = CStr(lines(i))

        If i = 1 And UCase(Trim(rawLine)) = "STAFF NAME,TEAM" Then GoTo ContinueImportLoop

        Dim fields() As String
        fields = ParseCSVLine(rawLine)

        If (UBound(fields) - LBound(fields) + 1) <> 2 Then
            malformed = malformed + 1
        Else
            Dim nm As String, tm As String
            nm = Trim(fields(0))
            tm = Trim(fields(1))
            If nm = "" Then
                malformed = malformed + 1
            Else
                ws.Cells(outRow, 1).Value = nm
                ws.Cells(outRow, 2).Value = tm
                outRow = outRow + 1
                loaded = loaded + 1
            End If
        End If
ContinueImportLoop:
    Next i

    ws.Columns("A:B").AutoFit

    Dim plural As String
    If loaded = 1 Then plural = "y" Else plural = "ies"
    MsgBox loaded & " roster entr" & plural & " loaded; " & malformed & _
        " malformed row(s) skipped.", vbInformation, "Import Complete"
End Sub

' Quotes a CSV field if it contains a comma, quote, or line break; doubles any
' embedded quotes. Plain fields are left unquoted.
Private Function CSVQuote(s As String) As String
    If InStr(s, ",") > 0 Or InStr(s, """") > 0 Or InStr(s, vbCr) > 0 Or InStr(s, vbLf) > 0 Then
        CSVQuote = """" & Replace(s, """", """""") & """"
    Else
        CSVQuote = s
    End If
End Function

' Parses one CSV line into a 0-based String array, honouring double-quoted
' fields (with "" as an escaped quote) so values like "LIM YONG CHIEW, DESMOND"
' survive a round trip through ExportStaffRoster / ImportStaffRoster.
Private Function ParseCSVLine(ln As String) As String()
    Dim result() As String
    Dim cap As Long
    cap = 10
    ReDim result(0 To cap - 1)
    Dim count As Long
    count = 0

    Dim i As Long, ch As String, field As String, inQuotes As Boolean
    inQuotes = False
    field = ""
    i = 1
    Do While i <= Len(ln)
        ch = Mid(ln, i, 1)
        If inQuotes Then
            If ch = """" Then
                If i < Len(ln) And Mid(ln, i + 1, 1) = """" Then
                    field = field & """"
                    i = i + 1
                Else
                    inQuotes = False
                End If
            Else
                field = field & ch
            End If
        Else
            If ch = """" Then
                inQuotes = True
            ElseIf ch = "," Then
                If count >= cap Then
                    cap = cap * 2
                    ReDim Preserve result(0 To cap - 1)
                End If
                result(count) = field
                count = count + 1
                field = ""
            Else
                field = field & ch
            End If
        End If
        i = i + 1
    Loop

    If count >= cap Then
        cap = cap + 1
        ReDim Preserve result(0 To cap - 1)
    End If
    result(count) = field
    count = count + 1

    ReDim Preserve result(0 To count - 1)
    ParseCSVLine = result
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "FilterFileB"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' FilterFileB.bas
'
' File B = Inflight Missed FC Report (Missed FC indicator ticked).
' Per the process flow doc (docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md):
'
'   Step 1 -- FilterFCModeIfPresent: optional FC Mode filter (CLAUDE.md notes
'                                     the Inflight FC Report may not have this
'                                     column at all -- no-op if absent)
'   Step 2 -- KeepOnlyMissedFC:       keep only rows where Missed FC = "Yes"
'   Step 3 -- DeleteCancelledOrPlanned: drop Admission Status = "Cancelled"/"Planned"
'   Step 4 -- FlagEDVWDischarges:     add an informational "EDVW Discharge" column
'                                     (does not remove rows -- everything left
'                                     after Step 3 counts toward Missed FC)
'
' Load-filter-write strategy: reads the sheet once into a Variant array,
' compacts matching rows in memory, writes back in one bulk operation.
' ============================================================

Private Const FC_MODE_AH       As String = "Financial Counselling - AH"
Private Const FC_MODE_DOWNTIME As String = "Financial Counselling - Downtime"

Private Const ADM_CANCELLED As String = "Cancelled"
Private Const ADM_PLANNED   As String = "Planned"

Private Const EDVW_POINT_OF_CARE   As String = "TTSH Virtual Ward"
Private Const EDVW_ACCOMMODATION   As String = "EDVW"

' Step 1 -- if File B has an "FC Mode" column, keep only Financial Counselling
' rows (same allowlist as File A). If the column doesn't exist, this is a no-op
' -- CLAUDE.md notes the Inflight FC Report may not include FC Mode at all.
Public Function FilterFCModeIfPresent(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim modeCol As Long
    modeCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Mode")
    If modeCol = 0 Then
        FilterFCModeIfPresent = True
        Exit Function   ' no FC Mode column on this export -- nothing to filter
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, modeCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        FilterFCModeIfPresent = True
        Exit Function
    End If
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ' Both sides run through NormalizeDashesAndSpaces -- see FilterFileA.FilterFCMode
    ' for why (the .docx guide's FC Mode text uses an en dash, not a hyphen).
    Dim keepCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim modeVal As String
    Dim modeAHNorm As String, modeDowntimeNorm As String
    modeAHNorm = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(FC_MODE_AH))
    modeDowntimeNorm = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(FC_MODE_DOWNTIME))
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        modeVal = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(allData(i, modeCol))))
        If modeVal = modeAHNorm Or modeVal = modeDowntimeNorm Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = lastRow - 1 Then
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        FilterFCModeIfPresent = True
        Exit Function   ' nothing to remove
    End If

    If keepCount = 0 Then
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).ClearContents
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        MsgBox "No Financial Counselling rows found in File B after the FC Mode filter." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the Inflight Missed FC Report export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        FilterFCModeIfPresent = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        modeVal = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(allData(i, modeCol))))
        If modeVal = modeAHNorm Or modeVal = modeDowntimeNorm Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData

    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "File B FC Mode filter complete: kept " & keepCount & " rows."
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    FilterFCModeIfPresent = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during File B FC Mode filter:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    FilterFCModeIfPresent = False

End Function

' Step 2 -- keeps only rows where "Missed FC" = "Yes". The Inflight Missed FC
' Report should already be exported with this indicator ticked, but this is a
' defensive filter in case the export includes other rows too.
Public Function KeepOnlyMissedFC(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim missedCol As Long
    missedCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Missed FC")
    If missedCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File B is missing the 'Missed FC' column." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the Inflight Missed FC Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        KeepOnlyMissedFC = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    KeepOnlyMissedFC = True

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, missedCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    Dim keepCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, missedCol)))) = "YES" Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = 0 Then
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).ClearContents
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        MsgBox "No rows with Missed FC = 'Yes' found in File B." & vbNewLine & _
               "Re-export with the Missed FC indicator ticked, or use the manual " & _
               "eFC dashboard workaround export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        KeepOnlyMissedFC = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, missedCol)))) = "YES" Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData

    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "Missed FC filter complete: kept " & keepCount & " rows."
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during Missed FC filter:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    KeepOnlyMissedFC = False

End Function

' Step 3 -- deletes rows where Admission Status = "Cancelled" or "Planned".
' Cancelled = upstream cancellation; Planned = patient never actualised in ward.
Public Function DeleteCancelledOrPlanned(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim admStatCol As Long
    admStatCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Admission Status")
    If admStatCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File B is missing the 'Admission Status' column." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the Inflight Missed FC Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        DeleteCancelledOrPlanned = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    DeleteCancelledOrPlanned = True

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, admStatCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    Dim keepCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim admVal As String
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        admVal = UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, admStatCol))))
        If admVal <> UCase(ADM_CANCELLED) And admVal <> UCase(ADM_PLANNED) Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = lastRow - 1 Then
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        Application.StatusBar = "Cancelled/Planned filter complete: no matching rows found."
        Exit Function
    End If

    If keepCount = 0 Then
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).ClearContents
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        MsgBox "All rows in File B have Admission Status = 'Cancelled' or 'Planned'." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the Inflight Missed FC Report export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        DeleteCancelledOrPlanned = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        admVal = UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, admStatCol))))
        If admVal <> UCase(ADM_CANCELLED) And admVal <> UCase(ADM_PLANNED) Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData

    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "Cancelled/Planned filter complete: removed " & (lastRow - 1 - keepCount) & " row(s)."
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during Cancelled/Planned filter:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    DeleteCancelledOrPlanned = False

End Function

' Step 4 -- adds an informational "EDVW Discharge" column flagging rows where
' Point Of Care = "TTSH Virtual Ward" and Accommodation Code = "EDVW". This is
' label-only: matching rows are NOT removed or excluded -- everything left
' after Step 3 still counts toward the Missed FC total. Staff use this column
' to see how many missed cases were EDVW short-stay discharges.
'
' If either source column is absent from this export, the column is not added
' at all (BuildOutput must handle "EDVW Discharge" being absent via
' FindColByHeader returning 0).
Public Sub FlagEDVWDischarges(ws As Worksheet)

    Dim pocCol As Long, accomCol As Long
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Point Of Care")
    ' The real export misspells this header as "Accomodation Code" (one "m") --
    ' try the correct spelling first, then the misspelling (1.3, 2026-07-30).
    accomCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Accommodation Code")
    If accomCol = 0 Then accomCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Accomodation Code")

    If pocCol = 0 Or accomCol = 0 Then
        Application.StatusBar = "EDVW discharge flag skipped: 'Point Of Care' / 'Accommodation Code' " & _
            "column not found on this export."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, pocCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim flagCol As Long
    flagCol = lastCol + 1
    ws.Cells(1, flagCol).Value = "EDVW Discharge"

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim pocData As Variant, accomData As Variant
    pocData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, pocCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, pocCol)).Value
    accomData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, accomCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, accomCol)).Value

    Dim flagData() As Variant
    ReDim flagData(1 To lastRow - 1, 1 To 1)

    Dim i As Long
    Dim pocVal As String, accomVal As String
    For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
        If lastRow = 2 Then
            pocVal = UCase(Trim(CStr(pocData)))
            accomVal = UCase(Trim(CStr(accomData)))
        Else
            pocVal = UCase(Trim(CStr(pocData(i, 1))))
            accomVal = UCase(Trim(CStr(accomData(i, 1))))
        End If

        If pocVal = UCase(EDVW_POINT_OF_CARE) And accomVal = UCase(EDVW_ACCOMMODATION) Then
            flagData(i, 1) = "Yes"
        Else
            flagData(i, 1) = ""
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, flagCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, flagCol)).Value = flagData

    Application.StatusBar = "EDVW discharge flag added."
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub

167	' locally here so it can never leave a slot stuck invalid after the conflict is

197	    End If

232	' crash on wb.Name), validates headers, updates the file/status labels, then
233	' recomputes cross-slot state.
234	Private Sub HandleSlotPick(ByRef slotWb As Workbook, title As String, fileType As String, _
235	                           lblFile As MSForms.Label, lblStatus As MSForms.Label, _
236	                           ByRef validFlag As Boolean)
237	    Dim wb As Workbook
238	    Set wb = PickFileWithFolder(title)
239	    If wb Is Nothing Then Exit Sub      ' user cancelled the dialog -- keep current selection
240	
241	    ' Release the slot's previous workbook, unless the user re-picked the same file
242	    ' (Workbooks.Open returns the already-open instance, so closing it would invalidate wb).
243	    If Not (slotWb Is wb) Then CloseSlotWorkbook slotWb
244	
245	    Set slotWb = wb
246	    lblFile.caption = wb.Name
247	    If ValidateFileHeaders(wb, fileType) Then
248	        validFlag = True
249	        lblStatus.caption = "Valid"
250	        lblStatus.ForeColor = RGB(0, 128, 0)
251	    Else
252	        validFlag = False
253	        lblStatus.caption = "Invalid"
254	        lblStatus.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
255	    End If
256	
257	    UpdateValidationStatus
258	End Sub

261	' same workbook object. (When the same file is chosen for both slots,
262	' Workbooks.Open hands back one shared instance; closing it for one slot would
263	' otherwise invalidate the other and crash on later access.)
264	Private Sub CloseSlotWorkbook(wbToClose As Workbook)
265	    If wbToClose Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
266	    Dim refs As Long
267	    If SelectedFileA Is wbToClose Then refs = refs + 1
268	    If SelectedFileB Is wbToClose Then refs = refs + 1
269	    If refs <= 1 Then
270	        On Error Resume Next
271	        wbToClose.Close SaveChanges:=False
272	        On Error GoTo 0
273	    End If
274	End Sub

277	' absent, but always validated so a stray non-numeric entry can't silently
278	' become 0). Blocks Generate with a MsgBox if invalid.
279	Private Sub m_btnGenerate_Click()
280	    Dim txt As String
281	    txt = Trim(m_txtMissedCount.Text)
282	
283	    If txt = "" Then txt = "0"
284	
285	    If Not IsNumeric(txt) Or CDbl(txt) < 0 Or CDbl(txt) <> Int(CDbl(txt)) Then
286	        MsgBox "Missed FC count (dashboard workaround) must be a whole number of 0 or more.", _
287	               vbExclamation, "Invalid Missed FC Count"
288	        Exit Sub
289	    End If
290	
291	    MissedFCManualCount = CLng(txt)
292	    Cancelled = False
293	    Me.Hide
294	End Sub
295	
296	Private Sub m_btnCancel_Click()
297	    Cancelled = True
298	    ' Close opened files
299	    On Error Resume Next
300	    If Not SelectedFileA Is Nothing Then SelectedFileA.Close SaveChanges:=False
301	    If Not SelectedFileB Is Nothing Then SelectedFileB.Close SaveChanges:=False
302	    On Error GoTo 0
303	    Me.Hide
304	End Sub
305	
306	Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)
307	    If CloseMode = vbFormControlMenu Then
308	        Cancel = 1
309	        m_btnCancel_Click
310	    End If
311	End Sub

    CreateLabel "lblMissedCount", "Missed FC count (dashboard workaround) -- used only if File B is not provided:", _
                20, 122, 460, 26, True
    Set m_txtMissedCount = Me.Controls.Add("Forms.TextBox.1", "txtMissedCount", True)
    m_txtMissedCount.left = 20
    m_txtMissedCount.top = 148
    m_txtMissedCount.width = 60
    m_txtMissedCount.height = 18
    m_txtMissedCount.Text = "0"

    ' Warning label (duplicate file / blank Missed FC column)
    Set m_lblWarning = CreateLabel("lblWarning", "", 20, 176, 460, 40, False)
    m_lblWarning.ForeColor = RGB(180, 80, 0) ' Dark Orange
    m_lblWarning.Font.Bold = True
    m_lblWarning.Visible = False

    ' Bottom Buttons
    Set m_btnGenerate = CreateButton("btnGenerate", "Generate Report", 240, 230, 110, 26)
    m_btnGenerate.Enabled = False
    Set m_btnCancel = CreateButton("btnCancel", "Cancel", 365, 230, 110, 26)
End Sub

Private Function CreateLabel(name As String, caption As String, left As Single, top As Single, width As Single, height As Single, bold As Boolean) As MSForms.Label
    Dim lbl As MSForms.Label
    Set lbl = Me.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", name, True)
    lbl.left = left
    lbl.top = top
    lbl.width = width
    lbl.height = height

Private Function CreateButton(name As String, caption As String, left As Single, top As Single, width As Single, height As Single) As MSForms.CommandButton
    Dim btn As MSForms.CommandButton
    Set btn = Me.Controls.Add("Forms.CommandButton.1", name, True)
    btn.left = left
    btn.top = top
    btn.width = width
    btn.height = height

Private Function PickFileWithFolder(title As String) As Workbook
    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFilePicker)
    fd.title = title
    fd.Filters.Clear
    fd.Filters.Add "Excel Files", "*.xlsx; *.xlsm; *.xls"

    If m_lastFolder <> "" Then fd.InitialFileName = m_lastFolder & "\"

    If fd.Show = -1 Then
        Dim filePath As String
        filePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)
        m_lastFolder = Left(filePath, InStrRev(filePath, "\") - 1)
        Set PickFileWithFolder = Workbooks.Open(filePath)
    Else
        Set PickFileWithFolder = Nothing
    End If
    AppActivate Me.Caption  ' return focus to the form after the file dialog closes
End Function

' Recomputes cross-slot state (duplicate-file conflict, Missed FC blank warning,
' and the Generate button) from the current selections. The m_validX flags hold
' ONLY header validity (set by HandleSlotPick); the duplicate conflict is tracked
' locally here so it can never leave a slot stuck invalid after the conflict is
' resolved on the other slot.
'
' File B is optional (Decision 5): Generate only requires File A. If File B
' HAS been selected, though, it must be header-valid before Generate enables --
' a chosen-but-invalid File B is a mistake worth blocking on, not silently
' ignoring.
Private Sub UpdateValidationStatus()
    Dim isDuplicate As Boolean
    isDuplicate = False

    ' Clear warning
    m_lblWarning.caption = ""
    m_lblWarning.Visible = False

    ' Duplicate file check
    If Not SelectedFileA Is Nothing And Not SelectedFileB Is Nothing Then
        If UCase(SelectedFileA.FullName) = UCase(SelectedFileB.FullName) Then isDuplicate = True
    End If

    If isDuplicate Then
        m_lblWarning.caption = "Same file selected for both File A and File B!"
        m_lblWarning.Visible = True
        ' Reflect the conflict on the File B slot WITHOUT clobbering its header-validity flag.
        m_lblFileBStatus.caption = "X Same file"
        m_lblFileBStatus.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
    ElseIf m_validB And Not SelectedFileB Is Nothing Then
        ' No conflict: restore File B's true status (it may have shown "X Same file").
        m_lblFileBStatus.caption = "Valid"
        m_lblFileBStatus.ForeColor = RGB(0, 128, 0)
    End If

    ' Missed FC column entirely blank -- workaround warning (CLAUDE.md)
    If Not isDuplicate And Not SelectedFileB Is Nothing And m_validB Then
        If IsMissedFCColumnBlank(SelectedFileB) Then
            m_lblWarning.caption = "File B's 'Missed FC' column is entirely blank." & vbNewLine & _
                "Re-export with the Missed FC indicator ticked, or leave File B unselected " & _
                "and enter the Missed FC count manually below (dashboard workaround)."
            m_lblWarning.Visible = True
        End If
    End If

    ' File B is optional: "ready" means either not selected at all, or selected
    ' and header-valid.
    Dim fileBReady As Boolean
    fileBReady = (SelectedFileB Is Nothing) Or m_validB

    ' Enable Generate once File A is valid, File B (if present) is valid, and
    ' the two files don't conflict.
    m_btnGenerate.Enabled = (m_validA And fileBReady And Not isDuplicate)
End Sub

Private Sub m_btnFileA_Click()
    HandleSlotPick SelectedFileA, "Select File A -- FC Summary Report", "FC_SUMMARY", _
                   m_lblFileAName, m_lblFileAStatus, m_validA
End Sub

Private Sub m_btnFileB_Click()
    HandleSlotPick SelectedFileB, "Select File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report", "INFLIGHT_MISSED", _
                   m_lblFileBName, m_lblFileBStatus, m_validB
End Sub

' Shared Browse handler for both slots. Picks a file, closes the slot's previous
' workbook (UNLESS the user re-picked the same file -- Workbooks.Open returns the
' already-open instance, so closing it would invalidate the new reference and
' crash on wb.Name), validates headers, updates the file/status labels, then
' recomputes cross-slot state.
Private Sub HandleSlotPick(ByRef slotWb As Workbook, title As String, fileType As String, _
                           lblFile As MSForms.Label, lblStatus As MSForms.Label, _
                           ByRef validFlag As Boolean)
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = PickFileWithFolder(title)
    If wb Is Nothing Then Exit Sub      ' user cancelled the dialog -- keep current selection

    ' Release the slot's previous workbook, unless the user re-picked the same file
    ' (Workbooks.Open returns the already-open instance, so closing it would invalidate wb).
    If Not (slotWb Is wb) Then CloseSlotWorkbook slotWb

    Set slotWb = wb
    lblFile.caption = wb.Name
    If ValidateFileHeaders(wb, fileType) Then
        validFlag = True
        lblStatus.caption = "Valid"
        lblStatus.ForeColor = RGB(0, 128, 0)
    Else
        validFlag = False
        lblStatus.caption = "Invalid"
        lblStatus.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
    End If

    UpdateValidationStatus
End Sub

' Closes a slot's workbook only if the OTHER slot does not still reference the
' same workbook object. (When the same file is chosen for both slots,
' Workbooks.Open hands back one shared instance; closing it for one slot would
' otherwise invalidate the other and crash on later access.)
Private Sub CloseSlotWorkbook(wbToClose As Workbook)
    If wbToClose Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    Dim refs As Long
    If SelectedFileA Is wbToClose Then refs = refs + 1
    If SelectedFileB Is wbToClose Then refs = refs + 1
    If refs <= 1 Then
        On Error Resume Next
        wbToClose.Close SaveChanges:=False
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
End Sub

' Validates the manual Missed FC count box (only meaningful when File B is
' absent, but always validated so a stray non-numeric entry can't silently
' become 0). Blocks Generate with a MsgBox if invalid.
Private Sub m_btnGenerate_Click()
    Dim txt As String
    txt = Trim(m_txtMissedCount.Text)

    If txt = "" Then txt = "0"

    If Not IsNumeric(txt) Or CDbl(txt) < 0 Or CDbl(txt) <> Int(CDbl(txt)) Then
        MsgBox "Missed FC count (dashboard workaround) must be a whole number of 0 or more.", _
               vbExclamation, "Invalid Missed FC Count"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    MissedFCManualCount = CLng(txt)
    Cancelled = False
    Me.Hide
End Sub

Private Sub m_btnCancel_Click()
    Cancelled = True
    ' Close opened files
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not SelectedFileA Is Nothing Then SelectedFileA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If Not SelectedFileB Is Nothing Then SelectedFileB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    On Error GoTo 0
    Me.Hide
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)
    If CloseMode = vbFormControlMenu Then
        Cancel = 1
        m_btnCancel_Click
    End If
End Sub

1	Attribute VB_Name = "BuildOutput"
2	Option Explicit
3	
4	' ============================================================
5	' BuildOutput.bas
6	'
7	' Builds the FC Completion Report output workbook:
8	'   - EM sheet (Emergency encounters from File A)
9	'   - EL sheet (Elective Inpatient encounters from File A -- every Elective
10	'     Inpatient encounter, no Point of Care gate -- see "Revert A" below)
11	'   - Missed FC sheet (File B data) -- SKIPPED when File B was not provided
12	'   - Summary sheet (reconciliation waterfall + six-band colour-coded
13	'     completion + team breakdown + NCID ward sub-block)
14	'   - Methodology sheet (plain-language rule explanation)
15	'   - Staff Roster Check sheet (roster coverage check, both directions)
16	'
17	' 2026-07-30 consolidated change set (validated against
18	' FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx, June 2026, against the team's manual
19	' report for the same month):
20	'
21	'   PART 1 -- data-value fixes: ADM_ELECTIVE now matches on a normalised
22	'     "ELECTIVE INPA" prefix (the export writes "Elective inpa", not
23	'     "Elective Inpatient"); date parsing fixed from D/M/Y to M/D/Y
24	'     (TryParseMDYDate, was TryParseDMYDate).
25	'
26	'   PART 2 -- REVERT A: the NCID Point of Care list is no longer a gate on
27	'     the EL sheet/stats -- EL is every Elective Inpatient encounter,
28	'     Admission Type alone (Q1's original answer was correct). REVERT B:
29	'     Voided/Deleted-only encounters (priority 99) are back IN the
30	'     denominator and IN "not completed" -- they get their own Summary row,
31	'     uncoloured, under the "Not completed (total)" subtotal. Priority 98/99
32	'     stay separately counted and reported (this split is unchanged). The FC
33	'     Mode filter still drops Shopper-only encounters entirely, but the count
34	'     of encounters lost that way is now surfaced on Summary/Methodology.
35	'
36	'   PART 3 -- output additions: NCID Point of Care becomes an informational
37	'     breakdown (not a gate) -- an "NCID Ward" Yes/No column on the EL sheet,
38	'     an "of which NCID wards" summary sub-block, and a warning for any
39	'     Point of Care value containing "NCID" that isn't in the configured
40	'     list. A small-denominator guard suppresses percentages under n=30. A
41	'     reconciliation waterfall on the Summary sheet lets the team verify the
42	'     macro's math against a manual run, with a visible balance-check row.
43	'
44	'   PART 4 -- staff roster: a roster coverage guard (MainMacro, before this
45	'     module runs) measures what fraction of encounters map to a named team;
46	'     BuildOutputWorkbook receives the result (rosterCoverage,
47	'     unmatchedNames, suppressTeamBlocks) purely for reporting/suppression.
48	' ============================================================
49	
50	Public Const SHEET_EM As String = "EM"
51	Public Const SHEET_EL As String = "EL"
52	Public Const SHEET_MISSED_FC As String = "Missed FC"
53	Public Const SHEET_SUMMARY As String = "Summary"
54	Public Const SHEET_METHODOLOGY As String = "Methodology"
55	Public Const SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK As String = "Staff Roster Check"
56	
57	Private Const ADM_EMERGENCY As String = "Emergency"
58	' The real export writes "Elective inpa" (truncated), not "Elective
59	' Inpatient" -- matched as a normalised UPPERCASE prefix (PART 1.1,
60	' 2026-07-30) via IsElectiveAdmType so the full word still matches if eFC
61	' ever writes it out in full.
62	Private Const ADM_ELECTIVE As String = "Elective inpa"
63	
64	' Section codes used in secArr() (see BuildOutputWorkbook):
65	'   1 = EM (Emergency)
66	'   2 = EL (Elective Inpatient -- Admission Type alone, PART 2 Revert A)
67	'   0 = neither -- excluded from both sheets, reported separately
68	Private Const SEC_EM As Long = 1
69	Private Const SEC_EL As Long = 2
70	
71	' ---- Date parsing (eFC export format) ------------------------------------
72	
73	' PART 1.2 (2026-07-30): the export writes dates as M/D/Y ("6/15/2026"), not
74	' D/M/Y. The old TryParseDMYDate read parts(0) as day and parts(1) as month,
75	' so DateSerial(2026, 15, 6) silently rolled over to March 2027 and every
76	' GetReportPeriodLabel call was wrong. Renamed to TryParseMDYDate, parses
77	' M/D/Y, and rejects out-of-range month/day instead of letting DateSerial
78	' roll over silently.
79	Private Function TryParseMDYDate(dateText As String, ByRef result As Date) As Boolean
80	    Dim datePart As String
81	    Dim spacePos As Long
82	    spacePos = InStr(dateText, " ")
83	    If spacePos > 0 Then
84	        datePart = Trim(Left(dateText, spacePos - 1))
85	    Else
86	        datePart = Trim(dateText)
87	    End If
88	
89	    Dim parts() As String
90	    parts = Split(datePart, "/")
91	    If UBound(parts) <> 2 Then
92	        TryParseMDYDate = False
93	        Exit Function
94	    End If
95	    If Not IsNumeric(parts(0)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(1)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(2)) Then
96	        TryParseMDYDate = False
97	        Exit Function
98	    End If
99	
100	    Dim m As Long, d As Long, y As Long
101	    m = CLng(parts(0)): d = CLng(parts(1)): y = CLng(parts(2))
102	    If y < 100 Then y = y + 2000
103	
104	    If m < 1 Or m > 12 Or d < 1 Or d > 31 Then
105	        TryParseMDYDate = False
106	        Exit Function
107	    End If
108	
109	    On Error GoTo Fail
110	    result = DateSerial(y, m, d)
111	    TryParseMDYDate = True
112	    Exit Function
113	Fail:
114	    TryParseMDYDate = False
115	End Function
116	
117	Public Function GetReportPeriodLabel(fileAws As Worksheet) As String
118	    Dim admDateCol As Long
119	    admDateCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Date")
120	    If admDateCol = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function
121	
122	    Dim encCol As Long
123	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
124	    If encCol = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function
125	
126	    Dim lastRow As Long
127	    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
128	    If lastRow < 2 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function
129	
130	    Dim data As Variant
131	    data = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, admDateCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, admDateCol)).Value
132	
133	    Dim counts As Object
134	    Set counts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
135	
136	    Dim i As Long, txt As String, parsed As Date, key As String
137	    For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
138	        If lastRow = 2 Then txt = CStr(data) Else txt = CStr(data(i, 1))
139	        If TryParseMDYDate(txt, parsed) Then
140	            key = Year(parsed) & "-" & Month(parsed)
141	            If counts.Exists(key) Then counts(key) = counts(key) + 1 Else counts(key) = 1
142	        End If
143	    Next i
144	
145	    If counts.Count = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function
146	
147	    Dim bestKey As String, bestCount As Long
148	    Dim k As Variant
149	    For Each k In counts.Keys
150	        If counts(k) > bestCount Then bestCount = counts(k): bestKey = CStr(k)
151	    Next k
152	
153	    Dim pts() As String
154	    pts = Split(bestKey, "-")
155	    GetReportPeriodLabel = MonthName(CLng(pts(1)), False) & CStr(CLng(pts(0)))
156	End Function
157	
158	' Returns True if admTypeUpper (already UCase'd) is Elective Inpatient --
159	' matched as a prefix against "ELECTIVE INPA" so both the export's truncated
160	' "Elective inpa" and a full "Elective Inpatient" match (PART 1.1, 2026-07-30).
161	Private Function IsElectiveAdmType(admTypeUpper As String) As Boolean
162	    Dim prefix As String
163	    prefix = UCase(ADM_ELECTIVE)
164	    IsElectiveAdmType = (Left(admTypeUpper, Len(prefix)) = prefix)
165	End Function

171	    d(TEAM_ED_EDFC) = 0
172	    d(TEAM_INFLIGHT) = 0

174	    d(TEAM_ICH_PSO) = 0

186	Private Sub FormatHeaderRow(ws As Worksheet, lastCol As Long)
187	    With ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(1, lastCol))
188	        .Font.Bold = True
189	        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 73, 125)
190	        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)

192	    On Error Resume Next
193	    ws.Rows(1).AutoFilter
194	    On Error GoTo 0

197	Private Function SafePct(num As Long, denom As Long) As Double
198	    If denom > 0 Then SafePct = num / denom Else SafePct = 0
199	End Function
200	
201	Private Function CellStr(v As Variant) As String
202	    CellStr = Trim(CStr(v))
203	End Function
204	
205	' Writes a percentage cell, UNLESS smallDenom is True (PART 3.2, 2026-07-30):
206	' below n=30, percentages are misleading at a department meeting, so the
207	' cell is left blank instead (the raw count column still shows the number).
208	Private Sub WritePctCell(ws As Worksheet, r As Long, c As Long, num As Long, denom As Long, smallDenom As Boolean)
209	    If smallDenom Then
210	        ws.Cells(r, c).Value = ""
211	    Else
212	        ws.Cells(r, c).Value = SafePct(num, denom)
213	        ws.Cells(r, c).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
214	    End If
215	End Sub
216	
217	' Buckets one row's FC Status priority into the six completion bands,
218	' incrementing the matching ByRef counter. Shared by the per-section
219	' (EM/EL) counters and the NCID-ward subset counters (PART 3.1) so the
220	' bucketing logic isn't duplicated.
221	Private Sub ClassifyIntoBand(pri As Long, ByRef greenC As Long, ByRef pinkC As Long, _
222	        ByRef ltGreenC As Long, ByRef orangeC As Long, ByRef draftC As Long, ByRef voidC As Long)
223	    If pri <= 2 Then
224	        greenC = greenC + 1
225	    ElseIf pri = 3 Then
226	        pinkC = pinkC + 1
227	    ElseIf pri <= 5 Then
228	        ltGreenC = ltGreenC + 1
229	    ElseIf pri = 6 Then
230	        orangeC = orangeC + 1
231	    ElseIf pri = 99 Then
232	        voidC = voidC + 1
233	    Else   ' 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, typos, new statuses
234	        draftC = draftC + 1
235	    End If
236	End Sub
237	
238	' ---- Write File A rows to a sheet, filtered by pre-computed section code -
239	
240	' secArr(i) holds the section code (SEC_EM / SEC_EL / 0) for fullData row i,
241	' computed once in BuildOutputWorkbook's main pass.
242	Private Function WriteFilteredFileASheet(ws As Worksheet, fullData As Variant, _
243	        totalRows As Long, outCols As Long, secArr() As Long, targetSec As Long) As Long
244	
245	    Dim matchCount As Long, i As Long, j As Long
246	    For i = 2 To totalRows
247	        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then matchCount = matchCount + 1
248	    Next i
249	
250	    For j = 1 To outCols
251	        ws.Cells(1, j).Value = fullData(1, j)
252	    Next j
253	
254	    If matchCount = 0 Then
255	        FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
256	        ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
257	        WriteFilteredFileASheet = 0
258	        Exit Function
259	    End If
260	
261	    Dim outArr() As Variant
262	    ReDim outArr(1 To matchCount, 1 To outCols)
263	    Dim outRow As Long
264	    For i = 2 To totalRows
265	        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then
266	            outRow = outRow + 1
267	            For j = 1 To outCols
268	                outArr(outRow, j) = fullData(i, j)
269	            Next j
270	        End If
271	    Next i
272	
273	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + matchCount, outCols)).Value = outArr
274	    FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
275	    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
276	    WriteFilteredFileASheet = matchCount
277	End Function
