279	' ---- Highlight rows where Latest CCF Creation User was blank (Q7) --------
280	
281	Private Sub HighlightCCFFallbackRows(ws As Worksheet)
282	    Dim latestCol As Long, closerCol As Long, encCol As Long
283	    latestCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
284	    closerCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "CCF Closed By")
285	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
286	    If latestCol = 0 Or closerCol = 0 Or encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub
287	
288	    Dim lastRow As Long
289	    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
290	    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
291	
292	    Dim rng As Range
293	    Dim i As Long
294	    For i = 2 To lastRow
295	        If CellStr(ws.Cells(i, latestCol).Value) = "" And _
296	           CellStr(ws.Cells(i, closerCol).Value) <> "" Then
297	            If rng Is Nothing Then
298	                Set rng = ws.Cells(i, closerCol)
299	            Else
300	                Set rng = Union(rng, ws.Cells(i, closerCol))
301	            End If
302	        End If
303	    Next i
304	
305	    If Not rng Is Nothing Then rng.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 153)
306	End Sub
307	
308	' ---- Write Missed FC sheet (File B data as-is) ---------------------------
309	
310	Private Sub WriteMissedFCSheet(ws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet)
311	    Dim encCol As Long
312	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
313	    If encCol = 0 Then
314	        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "No encounter column found in File B."
315	        Exit Sub
316	    End If
317	
318	    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
319	    lastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
320	    lastCol = fileBws.Cells(1, fileBws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
321	    If lastRow < 1 Or lastCol < 1 Then Exit Sub
322	
323	    Dim data As Variant
324	    data = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(1, 1), fileBws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value
325	
326	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value = data
327	    FormatHeaderRow ws, lastCol
328	    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
329	End Sub
330	
331	' ---- Reconciliation waterfall (PART 3.3, 2026-07-30) ----------------------
332	
333	' waterfall: Dictionary from MainMacro with keys "RowsLoaded",
334	' "RowsAfterModeFilter", "RowsAfterCancelledFilter", "UniqueEncounters",
335	' "DuplicateGroupsResolved", "DuplicateRowsRemoved",
336	' "EncountersLostToModeFilter" -- snapshots taken between File A cleaning
337	' steps. "Unique encounter numbers" and "Encounters carried forward" are the
338	' same figure (dedup leaves exactly one row per encounter) -- the "of which"
339	' lines below it are informational subsets already included in that count,
340	' not further subtractions. The balance-check row verifies EM + EL + neither
341	' reproduces that same figure.
342	Private Sub WriteReconciliationWaterfall(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, waterfall As Object, _
343	        missedTotal As Long, voidedTotal As Long, unrecognisedTotal As Long, _
344	        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, otherEncCount As Long)
345	
346	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "RECONCILIATION WATERFALL"
347	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
348	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
349	    r = r + 1
350	
351	    Dim rowsLoaded As Long, rowsAfterMode As Long, rowsAfterCancelled As Long
352	    Dim uniqueEnc As Long, dupGroups As Long, dupRowsRemoved As Long, lostToMode As Long
353	    rowsLoaded = CLng(waterfall("RowsLoaded"))
354	    rowsAfterMode = CLng(waterfall("RowsAfterModeFilter"))
355	    rowsAfterCancelled = CLng(waterfall("RowsAfterCancelledFilter"))
356	    uniqueEnc = CLng(waterfall("UniqueEncounters"))
357	    dupGroups = CLng(waterfall("DuplicateGroupsResolved"))
358	    dupRowsRemoved = CLng(waterfall("DuplicateRowsRemoved"))
359	    lostToMode = CLng(waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter"))

430	' Six colour bands: Green / Pink / Light Green / Orange / White-none (Draft,
431	' priority 98) / Voided-Deleted (priority 99, REVERT B -- back IN the

436	        title As String, encCount As Long, missedCount As Long, missedSourceLabel As String, _
437	        greenCt As Long, pinkCt As Long, ltGreenCt As Long, orangeCt As Long, draftCt As Long, voidedCt As Long, _

441	
442	    Dim denom As Long

446	
447	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = title
448	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
449	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
450	    r = r + 1
451	
452	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Denominator: " & denom & " encounters"
453	    If missedCount > 0 Then

455	            " (" & encCount & " from FC Summary + " & missedCount & " missed FC, source: " & _
456	            missedSourceLabel & ")"
457	    End If
458	    r = r + 1
459	    If smallDenom Then
460	        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "n too small for percentages (n < 30) -- counts only below."
461	        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
462	        r = r + 1
463	    End If

466	    ' ---- Completion status table (six colour bands) ----

470	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
471	    r = r + 1
472	
473	    ' Green (priority 1-2)
474	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completed with written acknowledgement"
475	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = greenCt

477	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(146, 208, 80)
478	    r = r + 1
479	
480	    ' Pink (priority 3)

482	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = pinkCt

484	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 203)

486	
487	    ' Light Green (priority 4-5)

491	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(198, 239, 206)
492	    r = r + 1
493	
494	    ' Orange (priority 6)
495	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC not completed"
496	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = orangeCt
497	    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, orangeCt, denom, smallDenom
498	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 0)
499	    r = r + 1
500	
501	    ' White/none (priority 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, unrecognised statuses)
502	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Draft only -- no FC outcome"
503	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = draftCt
504	    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, draftCt, denom, smallDenom
505	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
506	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
507	    r = r + 1
508	
509	    ' Voided/Deleted only (priority 99) -- REVERT B, 2026-07-30: counted IN
510	    ' the denominator and IN "not completed" now, not excluded. Uncoloured.
511	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted only"
512	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = voidedCt
513	    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, voidedCt, denom, smallDenom
514	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
515	    r = r + 1
516	
517	    ' Grey (File B / manual entry -- missed FC, no FC ID ever created)
518	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC -- no FC ID created"
519	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
520	    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, missedCount, denom, smallDenom
521	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(217, 217, 217)
522	    r = r + 1
523	
524	    ' Not completed (total) -- Orange + Draft + Voided + Missed.
525	    Dim notCompletedTotal As Long
526	    notCompletedTotal = orangeCt + draftCt + voidedCt + missedCount
527	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Not completed (total)"
528	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
529	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = notCompletedTotal
530	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Italic = True
531	    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, notCompletedTotal, denom, smallDenom
532	    ws.Cells(r, 3).Font.Italic = True
533	    r = r + 1
534	
535	    ' Total row -- visible sanity check that the bands sum to the denominator.
536	    Dim bandSum As Long
537	    bandSum = greenCt + pinkCt + ltGreenCt + orangeCt + draftCt + voidedCt + missedCount
538	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
539	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bandSum
540	    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, bandSum, denom, smallDenom
541	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
542	    If bandSum <> denom Then
543	        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "MISMATCH: bands sum to " & bandSum & " but denominator is " & _
544	            denom & " -- report this, there is a bug in the counting logic."
545	        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
546	        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
547	    End If
548	    r = r + 2
549	
550	    If suppressTeamBlocks Then
551	        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Who Closed the CCF / FC Activity Detail -- NOT AVAILABLE"
552	        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
553	        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
554	        r = r + 1
555	        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "The Config staff roster is empty or matched no names in this export -- " & _
556	            "team attribution is unavailable this run. See the Methodology sheet for details."

559	    End If
560	
561	    ' ---- Who closed the CCF ----
562	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Who Closed the CCF"
563	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
564	    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
565	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
566	    r = r + 1
567	
568	    Dim teams As Variant
569	    teams = Array(TEAM_ED_EDFC, TEAM_INFLIGHT, TEAM_NCID_AO, _
570	                  TEAM_ICH_PSO, TEAM_ADMIN, TEAM_OTHERS)
571	    Dim t As Long

575	        Dim tCount As Long

578	        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = tName
579	        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = tCount
580	        WritePctCell ws, r, 3, tCount, denom, smallDenom
581	        r = r + 1
582	    Next t
583	
584	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF not generated (Missed FC)"
585	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
586	    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, missedCount, denom, smallDenom
587	    r = r + 1
588	
589	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
590	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = denom
591	    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = 1
592	    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
593	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
594	
595	    If blankCCFCt > 0 Then
596	        r = r + 1
597	        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  (" & blankCCFCt & _
598	            " encounter(s) had blank 'Latest CCF Creation User' -- fell back to 'FC Created By')"
599	        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
600	    End If
601	    r = r + 2
602	
603	    ' ---- FC Activity Detail ----
604	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Activity Detail"
605	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
606	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
607	    r = r + 1
608	
609	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC created by EDFC (initial -- FC Created By)"
610	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = edInit

613	    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = edFull
614	    r = r + 1
615	    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by Inflight"

Attribute VB_Name = "BuildOutput"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' BuildOutput.bas
'
' Builds the FC Completion Report output workbook:
'   - EM sheet (Emergency encounters from File A)
'   - EL sheet (Elective Inpatient encounters from File A -- every Elective
'     Inpatient encounter, no Point of Care gate -- see "Revert A" below)
'   - Missed FC sheet (File B data) -- SKIPPED when File B was not provided
'   - Summary sheet (reconciliation waterfall + six-band colour-coded
'     completion + team breakdown + NCID ward sub-block)
'   - Methodology sheet (plain-language rule explanation)
'   - Staff Roster Check sheet (roster coverage check, both directions)
'
' 2026-07-30 consolidated change set (validated against
' FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx, June 2026, against the team's manual
' report for the same month):
'
'   PART 1 -- data-value fixes: ADM_ELECTIVE now matches on a normalised
'     "ELECTIVE INPA" prefix (the export writes "Elective inpa", not
'     "Elective Inpatient"); date parsing fixed from D/M/Y to M/D/Y
'     (TryParseMDYDate, was TryParseDMYDate).
'
'   PART 2 -- REVERT A: the NCID Point of Care list is no longer a gate on
'     the EL sheet/stats -- EL is every Elective Inpatient encounter,
'     Admission Type alone (Q1's original answer was correct). REVERT B:
'     Voided/Deleted-only encounters (priority 99) are back IN the
'     denominator and IN "not completed" -- they get their own Summary row,
'     uncoloured, under the "Not completed (total)" subtotal. Priority 98/99
'     stay separately counted and reported (this split is unchanged). The FC
'     Mode filter still drops Shopper-only encounters entirely, but the count
'     of encounters lost that way is now surfaced on Summary/Methodology.
'
'   PART 3 -- output additions: NCID Point of Care becomes an informational
'     breakdown (not a gate) -- an "NCID Ward" Yes/No column on the EL sheet,
'     an "of which NCID wards" summary sub-block, and a warning for any
'     Point of Care value containing "NCID" that isn't in the configured
'     list. A small-denominator guard suppresses percentages under n=30. A
'     reconciliation waterfall on the Summary sheet lets the team verify the
'     macro's math against a manual run, with a visible balance-check row.
'
'   PART 4 -- staff roster: a roster coverage guard (MainMacro, before this
'     module runs) measures what fraction of encounters map to a named team;
'     BuildOutputWorkbook receives the result (rosterCoverage,
'     unmatchedNames, suppressTeamBlocks) purely for reporting/suppression.
' ============================================================

Public Const SHEET_EM As String = "EM"
Public Const SHEET_EL As String = "EL"
Public Const SHEET_MISSED_FC As String = "Missed FC"
Public Const SHEET_SUMMARY As String = "Summary"
Public Const SHEET_METHODOLOGY As String = "Methodology"
Public Const SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK As String = "Staff Roster Check"

Private Const ADM_EMERGENCY As String = "Emergency"
' The real export writes "Elective inpa" (truncated), not "Elective
' Inpatient" -- matched as a normalised UPPERCASE prefix (PART 1.1,
' 2026-07-30) via IsElectiveAdmType so the full word still matches if eFC
' ever writes it out in full.
Private Const ADM_ELECTIVE As String = "Elective inpa"

' Section codes used in secArr() (see BuildOutputWorkbook):
'   1 = EM (Emergency)
'   2 = EL (Elective Inpatient -- Admission Type alone, PART 2 Revert A)
'   0 = neither -- excluded from both sheets, reported separately
Private Const SEC_EM As Long = 1
Private Const SEC_EL As Long = 2

' ---- Date parsing (eFC export format) ------------------------------------

' PART 1.2 (2026-07-30): the export writes dates as M/D/Y ("6/15/2026"), not
' D/M/Y. The old TryParseDMYDate read parts(0) as day and parts(1) as month,
' so DateSerial(2026, 15, 6) silently rolled over to March 2027 and every
' GetReportPeriodLabel call was wrong. Renamed to TryParseMDYDate, parses
' M/D/Y, and rejects out-of-range month/day instead of letting DateSerial
' roll over silently.
Private Function TryParseMDYDate(dateText As String, ByRef result As Date) As Boolean
    Dim datePart As String
    Dim spacePos As Long
    spacePos = InStr(dateText, " ")
    If spacePos > 0 Then
        datePart = Trim(Left(dateText, spacePos - 1))
    Else
        datePart = Trim(dateText)
    End If

    Dim parts() As String
    parts = Split(datePart, "/")
    If UBound(parts) <> 2 Then
        TryParseMDYDate = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Not IsNumeric(parts(0)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(1)) Or Not IsNumeric(parts(2)) Then
        TryParseMDYDate = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim m As Long, d As Long, y As Long
    m = CLng(parts(0)): d = CLng(parts(1)): y = CLng(parts(2))
    If y < 100 Then y = y + 2000

    If m < 1 Or m > 12 Or d < 1 Or d > 31 Then
        TryParseMDYDate = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    On Error GoTo Fail
    result = DateSerial(y, m, d)
    TryParseMDYDate = True
    Exit Function
Fail:
    TryParseMDYDate = False
End Function

Public Function GetReportPeriodLabel(fileAws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim admDateCol As Long
    admDateCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Date")
    If admDateCol = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    If encCol = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim data As Variant
    data = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(2, admDateCol), fileAws.Cells(lastRow, admDateCol)).Value

    Dim counts As Object
    Set counts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    Dim i As Long, txt As String, parsed As Date, key As String
    For i = 1 To (lastRow - 1)
        If lastRow = 2 Then txt = CStr(data) Else txt = CStr(data(i, 1))
        If TryParseMDYDate(txt, parsed) Then
            key = Year(parsed) & "-" & Month(parsed)
            If counts.Exists(key) Then counts(key) = counts(key) + 1 Else counts(key) = 1
        End If
    Next i

    If counts.Count = 0 Then GetReportPeriodLabel = "": Exit Function

    Dim bestKey As String, bestCount As Long
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In counts.Keys
        If counts(k) > bestCount Then bestCount = counts(k): bestKey = CStr(k)
    Next k

    Dim pts() As String
    pts = Split(bestKey, "-")
    GetReportPeriodLabel = MonthName(CLng(pts(1)), False) & CStr(CLng(pts(0)))
End Function

' Returns True if admTypeUpper (already UCase'd) is Elective Inpatient --
' matched as a prefix against "ELECTIVE INPA" so both the export's truncated
' "Elective inpa" and a full "Elective Inpatient" match (PART 1.1, 2026-07-30).
Private Function IsElectiveAdmType(admTypeUpper As String) As Boolean
    Dim prefix As String
    prefix = UCase(ADM_ELECTIVE)
    IsElectiveAdmType = (Left(admTypeUpper, Len(prefix)) = prefix)
End Function

' ---- Small helpers -------------------------------------------------------

Private Sub InitTeamCounts(d As Object)
    d.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    d(TEAM_ED_EDFC) = 0
    d(TEAM_INFLIGHT) = 0
    d(TEAM_NCID_AO) = 0
    d(TEAM_ICH_PSO) = 0
    d(TEAM_ADMIN) = 0
    d(TEAM_OTHERS) = 0
End Sub

Private Function AddSheet(wb As Workbook, sheetName As String) As Worksheet
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))
    ws.Name = sheetName
    Set AddSheet = ws
End Function

Private Sub FormatHeaderRow(ws As Worksheet, lastCol As Long)
    With ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(1, lastCol))
        .Font.Bold = True
        .Interior.Color = RGB(31, 73, 125)
        .Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End With
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Rows(1).AutoFilter
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Private Function SafePct(num As Long, denom As Long) As Double
    If denom > 0 Then SafePct = num / denom Else SafePct = 0
End Function

Private Function CellStr(v As Variant) As String
    CellStr = Trim(CStr(v))
End Function

' Writes a percentage cell, UNLESS smallDenom is True (PART 3.2, 2026-07-30):
' below n=30, percentages are misleading at a department meeting, so the
' cell is left blank instead (the raw count column still shows the number).
Private Sub WritePctCell(ws As Worksheet, r As Long, c As Long, num As Long, denom As Long, smallDenom As Boolean)
    If smallDenom Then
        ws.Cells(r, c).Value = ""
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, c).Value = SafePct(num, denom)
        ws.Cells(r, c).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    End If
End Sub

' Buckets one row's FC Status priority into the six completion bands,
' incrementing the matching ByRef counter. Shared by the per-section
' (EM/EL) counters and the NCID-ward subset counters (PART 3.1) so the
' bucketing logic isn't duplicated.
Private Sub ClassifyIntoBand(pri As Long, ByRef greenC As Long, ByRef pinkC As Long, _
        ByRef ltGreenC As Long, ByRef orangeC As Long, ByRef draftC As Long, ByRef voidC As Long)
    If pri <= 2 Then
        greenC = greenC + 1
    ElseIf pri = 3 Then
        pinkC = pinkC + 1
    ElseIf pri <= 5 Then
        ltGreenC = ltGreenC + 1
    ElseIf pri = 6 Then
        orangeC = orangeC + 1
    ElseIf pri = 99 Then
        voidC = voidC + 1
    Else   ' 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, typos, new statuses
        draftC = draftC + 1
    End If
End Sub

' ---- Write File A rows to a sheet, filtered by pre-computed section code -

' secArr(i) holds the section code (SEC_EM / SEC_EL / 0) for fullData row i,
' computed once in BuildOutputWorkbook's main pass.
Private Function WriteFilteredFileASheet(ws As Worksheet, fullData As Variant, _
        totalRows As Long, outCols As Long, secArr() As Long, targetSec As Long) As Long

    Dim matchCount As Long, i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To totalRows
        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then matchCount = matchCount + 1
    Next i

    For j = 1 To outCols
        ws.Cells(1, j).Value = fullData(1, j)
    Next j

    If matchCount = 0 Then
        FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
        ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
        WriteFilteredFileASheet = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim outArr() As Variant
    ReDim outArr(1 To matchCount, 1 To outCols)
    Dim outRow As Long
    For i = 2 To totalRows
        If secArr(i) = targetSec Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To outCols
                outArr(outRow, j) = fullData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + matchCount, outCols)).Value = outArr
    FormatHeaderRow ws, outCols
    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
    WriteFilteredFileASheet = matchCount
End Function

' ---- Highlight rows where Latest CCF Creation User was blank (Q7) --------

Private Sub HighlightCCFFallbackRows(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim latestCol As Long, closerCol As Long, encCol As Long
    latestCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    closerCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "CCF Closed By")
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If latestCol = 0 Or closerCol = 0 Or encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim rng As Range
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If CellStr(ws.Cells(i, latestCol).Value) = "" And _
           CellStr(ws.Cells(i, closerCol).Value) <> "" Then
            If rng Is Nothing Then
                Set rng = ws.Cells(i, closerCol)
            Else
                Set rng = Union(rng, ws.Cells(i, closerCol))
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If Not rng Is Nothing Then rng.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 153)
End Sub

' ---- Write Missed FC sheet (File B data as-is) ---------------------------

Private Sub WriteMissedFCSheet(ws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet)
    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
    If encCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "No encounter column found in File B."
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    lastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    lastCol = fileBws.Cells(1, fileBws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    If lastRow < 1 Or lastCol < 1 Then Exit Sub

    Dim data As Variant
    data = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(1, 1), fileBws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value = data
    FormatHeaderRow ws, lastCol
    ws.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
End Sub

' ---- Reconciliation waterfall (PART 3.3, 2026-07-30) ----------------------

' waterfall: Dictionary from MainMacro with keys "RowsLoaded",
' "RowsAfterModeFilter", "RowsAfterCancelledFilter", "UniqueEncounters",
' "DuplicateGroupsResolved", "DuplicateRowsRemoved",
' "EncountersLostToModeFilter" -- snapshots taken between File A cleaning
' steps. "Unique encounter numbers" and "Encounters carried forward" are the
' same figure (dedup leaves exactly one row per encounter) -- the "of which"
' lines below it are informational subsets already included in that count,
' not further subtractions. The balance-check row verifies EM + EL + neither
' reproduces that same figure.
Private Sub WriteReconciliationWaterfall(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, waterfall As Object, _
        missedTotal As Long, voidedTotal As Long, unrecognisedTotal As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, otherEncCount As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "RECONCILIATION WATERFALL"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    Dim rowsLoaded As Long, rowsAfterMode As Long, rowsAfterCancelled As Long
    Dim uniqueEnc As Long, dupGroups As Long, dupRowsRemoved As Long, lostToMode As Long
    rowsLoaded = CLng(waterfall("RowsLoaded"))
    rowsAfterMode = CLng(waterfall("RowsAfterModeFilter"))
    rowsAfterCancelled = CLng(waterfall("RowsAfterCancelledFilter"))
    uniqueEnc = CLng(waterfall("UniqueEncounters"))
    dupGroups = CLng(waterfall("DuplicateGroupsResolved"))
    dupRowsRemoved = CLng(waterfall("DuplicateRowsRemoved"))
    lostToMode = CLng(waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter"))

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Rows in File A as loaded"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = rowsLoaded
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  less rows dropped by FC Mode filter"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = -(rowsLoaded - rowsAfterMode)
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  less rows dropped by Cancelled filter"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = -(rowsAfterMode - rowsAfterCancelled)
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Unique encounter numbers"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = uniqueEnc
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  less duplicate rows removed by dedup (" & dupGroups & " encounter(s) had duplicates)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = -dupRowsRemoved
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Encounters carried forward"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = uniqueEnc
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  of which Voided/Deleted only (informational, still counted)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = voidedTotal
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  of which unrecognised status (informational, still counted)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unrecognisedTotal
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  encounters lost entirely to the FC Mode filter (informational -- e.g. Shopper-only)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = lostToMode
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "plus missed FC (File B or manual entry)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedTotal
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "= DENOMINATOR"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = uniqueEnc + missedTotal
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim splitSum As Long
    splitSum = emEnc + elEnc + otherEncCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Check: EM (" & emEnc & ") + EL (" & elEnc & ") + neither (" & _
        otherEncCount & ") = " & splitSum & " vs. encounters carried forward (" & uniqueEnc & ")"
    If splitSum <> uniqueEnc Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "MISMATCH -- there is a bug in the counting logic, report this."
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Bold = True
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(0, 128, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "OK -- balances."
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Color = RGB(0, 128, 0)
    End If
    r = r + 2
End Sub

' ---- Summary sheet -------------------------------------------------------

' Six colour bands: Green / Pink / Light Green / Orange / White-none (Draft,
' priority 98) / Voided-Deleted (priority 99, REVERT B -- back IN the
' denominator and "not completed", 2026-07-30) / Grey (Missed FC). A "Not
' completed (total)" subtotal (Orange + Draft + Voided + Missed) keeps the
' single headline figure available.
Private Sub WriteSummaryBlock(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, _
        title As String, encCount As Long, missedCount As Long, missedSourceLabel As String, _
        greenCt As Long, pinkCt As Long, ltGreenCt As Long, orangeCt As Long, draftCt As Long, voidedCt As Long, _
        teamD As Object, blankCCFCt As Long, _
        edInit As Long, edFull As Long, inflFull As Long, ncidFull As Long, _
        suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean)

    Dim denom As Long
    denom = encCount + missedCount
    Dim smallDenom As Boolean
    smallDenom = (denom < 30)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = title
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Denominator: " & denom & " encounters"
    If missedCount > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = ws.Cells(r, 1).Value & _
            " (" & encCount & " from FC Summary + " & missedCount & " missed FC, source: " & _
            missedSourceLabel & ")"
    End If
    r = r + 1
    If smallDenom Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "n too small for percentages (n < 30) -- counts only below."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 1
    End If
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- Completion status table (six colour bands) ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Completion Status"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ' Green (priority 1-2)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completed with written acknowledgement"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = greenCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, greenCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(146, 208, 80)
    r = r + 1

    ' Pink (priority 3)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF explained but not signed"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = pinkCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, pinkCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 203)
    r = r + 1

    ' Light Green (priority 4-5)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Attempted, no further follow-up"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = ltGreenCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, ltGreenCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(198, 239, 206)
    r = r + 1

    ' Orange (priority 6)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC not completed"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = orangeCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, orangeCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 192, 0)
    r = r + 1

    ' White/none (priority 98 -- Draft variants, blanks, unrecognised statuses)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Draft only -- no FC outcome"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = draftCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, draftCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
    r = r + 1

    ' Voided/Deleted only (priority 99) -- REVERT B, 2026-07-30: counted IN
    ' the denominator and IN "not completed" now, not excluded. Uncoloured.
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted only"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = voidedCt
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, voidedCt, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
    r = r + 1

    ' Grey (File B / manual entry -- missed FC, no FC ID ever created)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC -- no FC ID created"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, missedCount, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Interior.Color = RGB(217, 217, 217)
    r = r + 1

    ' Not completed (total) -- Orange + Draft + Voided + Missed.
    Dim notCompletedTotal As Long
    notCompletedTotal = orangeCt + draftCt + voidedCt + missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Not completed (total)"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = notCompletedTotal
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Font.Italic = True
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, notCompletedTotal, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Font.Italic = True
    r = r + 1

    ' Total row -- visible sanity check that the bands sum to the denominator.
    Dim bandSum As Long
    bandSum = greenCt + pinkCt + ltGreenCt + orangeCt + draftCt + voidedCt + missedCount
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bandSum
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, bandSum, denom, smallDenom
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    If bandSum <> denom Then
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "MISMATCH: bands sum to " & bandSum & " but denominator is " & _
            denom & " -- report this, there is a bug in the counting logic."
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
    End If
    r = r + 2

    If suppressTeamBlocks Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Who Closed the CCF / FC Activity Detail -- NOT AVAILABLE"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        r = r + 1
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "The Config staff roster is empty or matched no names in this export -- " & _
            "team attribution is unavailable this run. See the Methodology sheet for details."
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' ---- Who closed the CCF ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Who Closed the CCF"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim teams As Variant
    teams = Array(TEAM_ED_EDFC, TEAM_INFLIGHT, TEAM_NCID_AO, _
                  TEAM_ICH_PSO, TEAM_ADMIN, TEAM_OTHERS)
    Dim t As Long
    For t = LBound(teams) To UBound(teams)
        Dim tName As String
        tName = CStr(teams(t))
        Dim tCount As Long
        tCount = 0
        If teamD.Exists(tName) Then tCount = teamD(tName)
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = tName
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = tCount
        WritePctCell ws, r, 3, tCount, denom, smallDenom
        r = r + 1
    Next t

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF not generated (Missed FC)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = missedCount
    WritePctCell ws, r, 3, missedCount, denom, smallDenom
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Total"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = denom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = 1
    ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True

    If blankCCFCt > 0 Then
        r = r + 1
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  (" & blankCCFCt & _
            " encounter(s) had blank 'Latest CCF Creation User' -- fell back to 'FC Created By')"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- FC Activity Detail ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Activity Detail"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Count"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC created by EDFC (initial -- FC Created By)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = edInit
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by EDFC (Latest CCF Creation User)"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = edFull
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by Inflight"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = inflFull
    r = r + 1
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "CCF closed by NCID AO"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = ncidFull
    r = r + 3
End Sub

Private Sub WriteSummarySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, waterfall As Object, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedFCSourceLabel As String, _
        emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, emOrange As Long, emDraft As Long, emVoided As Long, _
        elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long, elOrange As Long, elDraft As Long, elVoided As Long, _
        emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object, _
        emBlankCCF As Long, elBlankCCF As Long, _
        emEdInit As Long, emEdFull As Long, emInflFull As Long, emNcidFull As Long, _
        elEdInit As Long, elEdFull As Long, elInflFull As Long, elNcidFull As Long, _
        ncidEnc As Long, ncidGreen As Long, ncidPink As Long, ncidLtGreen As Long, ncidOrange As Long, _
        ncidDraft As Long, ncidVoided As Long, ncidTeams As Object, ncidBlankCCF As Long, _
        ncidEdInit As Long, ncidEdFull As Long, ncidInflFull As Long, ncidNcidFull As Long, _
        voidedTotal As Long, otherEncCount As Long, missedOther As Long, _
        unrecognisedStatuses As Object, unmatchedNCIDWards As Object, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        modeFilterExcludedEncounters As Long, _
        suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean, rosterCoverage As Double, unmatchedNames As Object)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completion Report -- " & reportLabel
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Reconciliation waterfall (PART 3.3) ----
    WriteReconciliationWaterfall ws, r, waterfall, missedEM + missedEL + missedOther, _
        voidedTotal, unrecognisedStatuses.Count, emEnc, elEnc, otherEncCount

    If suppressTeamBlocks Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "STAFF ROSTER NOT MATCHED -- team attribution and all four " & _
            "numerator indicators are unavailable this run (the Config roster is empty or matched " & _
            "no names in this export). Completion statistics below are still valid."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        r = r + 2
    End If

    ' ---- EM block (always computed) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "EMERGENCY (EM) ADMISSIONS", _
        emEnc, missedEM, missedFCSourceLabel, emGreen, emPink, emLtGreen, emOrange, emDraft, emVoided, _
        emTeams, emBlankCCF, emEdInit, emEdFull, emInflFull, emNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- EL block (Revert A, 2026-07-30: always computed -- Admission Type alone) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "ELECTIVE INPATIENT (EL) ADMISSIONS", _
        elEnc, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, elGreen, elPink, elLtGreen, elOrange, elDraft, elVoided, _
        elTeams, elBlankCCF, elEdInit, elEdFull, elInflFull, elNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- of which NCID wards (PART 3.1 sub-block under EL) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "  of which NCID wards (subset of EL)", _
        ncidEnc, 0, missedFCSourceLabel, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoided, _
        ncidTeams, ncidBlankCCF, ncidEdInit, ncidEdFull, ncidInflFull, ncidNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- Combined block ----
    Dim combTeams As Object
    Set combTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts combTeams
    Dim tk As Variant
    For Each tk In emTeams.Keys
        combTeams(CStr(tk)) = emTeams(CStr(tk)) + elTeams(CStr(tk))
    Next tk

    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "COMBINED (EM + EL)", _
        emEnc + elEnc, missedEM + missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        emGreen + elGreen, emPink + elPink, emLtGreen + elLtGreen, emOrange + elOrange, _
        emDraft + elDraft, emVoided + elVoided, _
        combTeams, emBlankCCF + elBlankCCF, _
        emEdInit + elEdInit, emEdFull + elEdFull, _
        emInflFull + elInflFull, emNcidFull + elNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- FOOTNOTES ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FOOTNOTES"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted-only encounters (counted IN the denominator and IN " & _
        "'not completed', REVERT B 2026-07-30): " & voidedTotal
    r = r + 1

    If otherEncCount > 0 Or missedOther > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Encounters with unrecognised Admission Type (not EM or EL): " & _
            otherEncCount & " from File A, " & missedOther & " from File B"
        r = r + 1
    End If

    If modeFilterExcludedEncounters > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = modeFilterExcludedEncounters & " encounter(s) excluded -- only form " & _
            "was a Shopper enquiry or other non-FC mode."
        r = r + 1
    End If

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC source: " & missedFCSourceLabel
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Inflight duplicate exception applied (ED/EDFC candidate present, winner " & _
        "priority <= 2): " & inflightExceptionApplied & " encounter(s); blocked by the priority " & _
        "guard and fell back to the plain lowest-priority rule: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " encounter(s)"
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Unrecognised FC Status warning block ----
    If Not unrecognisedStatuses Is Nothing Then
        If unrecognisedStatuses.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "UNRECOGNISED FC STATUS VALUES (counted as 'Draft only -- no FC " & _
                "outcome', priority 98 -- still IN the denominator, but check for typos or new eFC statuses)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim uk As Variant
            For Each uk In unrecognisedStatuses.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(uk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unrecognisedStatuses(uk)
                r = r + 1
            Next uk
            r = r + 1
        End If
    End If

    ' ---- Unmatched "NCID" Point of Care values warning (PART 3.1) ----
    If Not unmatchedNCIDWards Is Nothing Then
        If unmatchedNCIDWards.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "POINT OF CARE VALUES CONTAINING 'NCID' NOT IN THE CONFIGURED LIST " & _
                "(still counted normally -- check whether a new NCID ward needs adding to the Config " & _
                "sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim nk As Variant
            For Each nk In unmatchedNCIDWards.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(nk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unmatchedNCIDWards(nk)
                r = r + 1
            Next nk
            r = r + 1
        End If
    End If

    ' ---- Low roster coverage: unmatched staff names (PART 4.1) ----
    If Not suppressTeamBlocks And rosterCoverage < 0.7 And rosterCoverage > 0 Then
        If Not unmatchedNames Is Nothing Then
            If unmatchedNames.Count > 0 Then
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "LOW ROSTER COVERAGE (" & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%") & _
                    ") -- UNMATCHED STAFF NAMES (add these to the Config roster for the biggest gain)"
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
                r = r + 1

                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Staff Name (as it appears in this export)"
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Encounter Count"
                ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
                r = r + 1

                Dim sortedNames As Variant
                sortedNames = SortDictKeysDescending(unmatchedNames)
                Dim si As Long
                For si = LBound(sortedNames) To UBound(sortedNames)
                    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(sortedNames(si))
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unmatchedNames(CStr(sortedNames(si)))
                    r = r + 1
                Next si
                r = r + 1
            End If
        End If
    End If

    ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 70
    ws.Columns("B:B").ColumnWidth = 12
    ws.Columns("C:C").ColumnWidth = 10
    ws.Columns("D:D").ColumnWidth = 50
End Sub

' ---- Methodology sheet ---------------------------------------------------

Private Sub WriteMethodologySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, _
        voidedTotal As Long, missedFCSourceLabel As String, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        unrecognisedStatusCount As Long, modeFilterExcludedEncounters As Long, _
        suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean, rosterCoverage As Double)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Methodology -- FC Completion Report " & reportLabel
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 2

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "1. INPUTS"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True

' ---- Main orchestrator ---------------------------------------------------

' fileBws may be Nothing (File B is optional). When Nothing, missedFCManualCount
' (from FilePickerForm's dashboard-workaround input) is used instead,
' attributed entirely to EM (see WriteMethodologySheet Section 1).
'
' ncidPocList: Dictionary from Helpers.LoadNCIDPointOfCareList -- purely
' informational (PART 3.1); does NOT gate the EL sheet (Revert A).
'
' waterfall: Dictionary from MainMacro with the row/encounter-count snapshots
' for the reconciliation waterfall (see WriteReconciliationWaterfall).
'
' rosterCoverage / unmatchedNames / suppressTeamBlocks: from Helpers.
' ComputeRosterCoverage, run in MainMacro before this function (PART 4.1).
Public Function BuildOutputWorkbook(fileAws As Worksheet, fileBws As Worksheet, _
        roster As Object, ncidPocList As Object, missedFCManualCount As Long, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        waterfall As Object, _
        rosterCoverage As Double, unmatchedNames As Object, suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    BuildOutputWorkbook = True

    Dim hasFileB As Boolean
    hasFileB = Not (fileBws Is Nothing)

    ' ---- Validate required File A columns ----
    Dim encCol As Long, admTypeCol As Long, fcStatusCol As Long
    Dim createdByCol As Long, latestCCFCol As Long, priCol As Long, pocCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(fileAws)
    admTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Admission Type")
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Status")
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "FC Created By")
    latestCCFCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    priCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "PRIORITISE")
    pocCol = FindColByHeader(fileAws, "Point of Care")

    If encCol = 0 Or admTypeCol = 0 Or fcStatusCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing a required column (Encounter Number, " & _
               "Admission Type, or FC Status).", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        BuildOutputWorkbook = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' ---- Read File A data ----
    Dim aLastRow As Long, aLastCol As Long
    aLastRow = fileAws.Cells(fileAws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    aLastCol = fileAws.Cells(1, fileAws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim aData As Variant
    aData = fileAws.Range(fileAws.Cells(1, 1), fileAws.Cells(aLastRow, aLastCol)).Value

    ' ---- Build expanded array with extra columns ----
    Dim outCols As Long
    outCols = aLastCol + 4
    Dim ccfCloserCol As Long, ccfTeamCol As Long, looksWrongCol As Long, ncidWardCol As Long
    ccfCloserCol = aLastCol + 1
    ccfTeamCol = aLastCol + 2
    looksWrongCol = aLastCol + 3
    ncidWardCol = aLastCol + 4

    Dim fullData() As Variant
    ReDim fullData(1 To aLastRow, 1 To outCols)

    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    For i = 1 To aLastRow
        For j = 1 To aLastCol
            fullData(i, j) = aData(i, j)
        Next j
    Next i

    fullData(1, ccfCloserCol) = "CCF Closed By"
    fullData(1, ccfTeamCol) = "CCF Closer Team"
    fullData(1, looksWrongCol) = "Looks Wrong"
    fullData(1, ncidWardCol) = "NCID Ward"

    ' secArr(i) = section for fullData row i: SEC_EM, SEC_EL, or 0 (neither).
    Dim secArr() As Long
    ReDim secArr(1 To aLastRow)

    ' ---- Compute extra columns + stats in one pass ----
    Dim greenCt(1 To 2) As Long, pinkCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim ltGreenCt(1 To 2) As Long, orangeCt(1 To 2) As Long, draftCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim encCt(1 To 2) As Long, voidCt(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim blankCCF(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim edInit(1 To 2) As Long, edFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim inflFull(1 To 2) As Long, ncidFull(1 To 2) As Long
    Dim otherEncCount As Long

    ' NCID ward subset (of EL) -- PART 3.1
    Dim ncidEnc As Long, ncidGreen As Long, ncidPink As Long, ncidLtGreen As Long
    Dim ncidOrange As Long, ncidDraft As Long, ncidVoid As Long, ncidBlankCCF As Long
    Dim ncidEdInit As Long, ncidEdFull As Long, ncidInflFull As Long, ncidNcidFull As Long
    Dim ncidTeams As Object
    Set ncidTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts ncidTeams

    Dim emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object
    Set emTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set elTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts emTeams
    InitTeamCounts elTeams

    Dim unrecognisedStatuses As Object
    Set unrecognisedStatuses = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unrecognisedStatuses.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim unmatchedNCIDWards As Object
    Set unmatchedNCIDWards = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    unmatchedNCIDWards.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        ' Resolve CCF closer
        Dim latestCCF As String
        latestCCF = ""
        If latestCCFCol > 0 Then latestCCF = CellStr(fullData(i, latestCCFCol))

        Dim createdBy As String
        createdBy = ""
        If createdByCol > 0 Then createdBy = CellStr(fullData(i, createdByCol))

        Dim ccfCloser As String
        Dim usedFallback As Boolean
        usedFallback = False
        If latestCCF <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = latestCCF
        ElseIf createdBy <> "" Then
            ccfCloser = createdBy
            usedFallback = True
        Else
            ccfCloser = ""
            usedFallback = True
        End If

        Dim team As String
        team = GetStaffTeam(roster, ccfCloser)

        fullData(i, ccfCloserCol) = ccfCloser
        fullData(i, ccfTeamCol) = team

        ' NCID Ward informational column + unmatched-"NCID"-value warning (PART 3.1)
        Dim pocValRaw As String
        pocValRaw = ""
        If pocCol > 0 Then pocValRaw = CellStr(fullData(i, pocCol))

        Dim isNCIDWard As Boolean
        isNCIDWard = (pocValRaw <> "" And ncidPocList.Exists(pocValRaw))
        If isNCIDWard Then
            fullData(i, ncidWardCol) = "Yes"
        Else
            fullData(i, ncidWardCol) = "No"
        End If

        If pocValRaw <> "" And InStr(UCase(pocValRaw), "NCID") > 0 And Not ncidPocList.Exists(pocValRaw) Then
            If unmatchedNCIDWards.Exists(pocValRaw) Then
                unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) = unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) + 1
            Else
                unmatchedNCIDWards(pocValRaw) = 1
            End If
        End If

        ' Determine section: SEC_EM, SEC_EL (Admission Type alone -- Revert A), or 0 = neither.
        Dim admType As String
        admType = UCase(CellStr(fullData(i, admTypeCol)))

        Dim sec As Long
        If admType = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
            sec = SEC_EM
        ElseIf IsElectiveAdmType(admType) Then
            sec = SEC_EL
        Else
            sec = 0
            otherEncCount = otherEncCount + 1
        End If
        secArr(i) = sec

        ' Looks Wrong flag
        If sec = SEC_EM And team = TEAM_NCID_AO Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        ElseIf sec = SEC_EL And (team = TEAM_ED_EDFC Or team = TEAM_INFLIGHT) Then
            fullData(i, looksWrongCol) = "Check"
        End If

        ' Stats (EM and EL only)
        If sec > 0 Then
            Dim pri As Long
            If priCol > 0 Then
                If IsNumeric(fullData(i, priCol)) Then
                    pri = CLng(fullData(i, priCol))
                Else
                    pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
                End If
            Else
                pri = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol)))
            End If

            encCt(sec) = encCt(sec) + 1
            ClassifyIntoBand pri, greenCt(sec), pinkCt(sec), ltGreenCt(sec), orangeCt(sec), draftCt(sec), voidCt(sec)

            If pri = 98 Then
                ' Known "Draft" family variants (Draft, Draft (CCF Generated),
                ' Draft (ETBS Generated), ...) are an EXPECTED priority-98
                ' outcome, not an anomaly -- only genuinely unexpected text
                ' (blank, typo, brand-new eFC status) goes into the warning
                ' dictionary. Matches the real export: "Draft"/"Draft (CCF
                ' Generated)"/"Draft (ETBS Generated)" are common and normal;
                ' flagging them as "unrecognised" would cry wolf every month.
                Dim statusText As String
                statusText = CellStr(fullData(i, fcStatusCol))
                If statusText = "" Then statusText = "(blank)"
                If InStr(UCase(statusText), "DRAFT") = 0 Then
                    If unrecognisedStatuses.Exists(statusText) Then
                        unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) = unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) + 1
                    Else
                        unrecognisedStatuses(statusText) = 1
                    End If
                End If
            End If

            Dim teamDict As Object
            If sec = SEC_EM Then Set teamDict = emTeams Else Set teamDict = elTeams
            teamDict(team) = teamDict(team) + 1

            If usedFallback Then blankCCF(sec) = blankCCF(sec) + 1

            ' Numerator detail
            Dim cbTeam As String, lcTeam As String
            cbTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, createdBy)
            lcTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, latestCCF)
            If cbTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then edInit(sec) = edInit(sec) + 1
            If lcTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then edFull(sec) = edFull(sec) + 1
            If lcTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then inflFull(sec) = inflFull(sec) + 1
            If lcTeam = TEAM_NCID_AO Then ncidFull(sec) = ncidFull(sec) + 1

            ' NCID ward subset of EL (PART 3.1)
            If sec = SEC_EL And isNCIDWard Then
                ncidEnc = ncidEnc + 1
                ClassifyIntoBand pri, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoid
                ncidTeams(team) = ncidTeams(team) + 1
                If usedFallback Then ncidBlankCCF = ncidBlankCCF + 1
                If cbTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then ncidEdInit = ncidEdInit + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then ncidEdFull = ncidEdFull + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then ncidInflFull = ncidInflFull + 1
                If lcTeam = TEAM_NCID_AO Then ncidNcidFull = ncidNcidFull + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ' ---- Missed FC count: File B (split by Admission Type) or manual entry ----
    Dim missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedOther As Long
    Dim missedFCSourceLabel As String

    If hasFileB Then
        missedFCSourceLabel = "Inflight Missed FC Report"

        Dim bEncCol As Long
        bEncCol = FindEncounterCol(fileBws)
        If bEncCol > 0 Then
            Dim bLastRow As Long
            bLastRow = fileBws.Cells(fileBws.Rows.Count, bEncCol).End(xlUp).Row

            If bLastRow >= 2 Then
                Dim bAdmTypeCol As Long
                bAdmTypeCol = FindColByHeader(fileBws, "Admission Type")

                If bAdmTypeCol > 0 Then
                    Dim bAdmData As Variant
                    bAdmData = fileBws.Range(fileBws.Cells(2, bAdmTypeCol), _
                        fileBws.Cells(bLastRow, bAdmTypeCol)).Value

                    Dim bi As Long
                    For bi = 1 To bLastRow - 1
                        Dim bAdmVal As String
                        If bLastRow = 2 Then
                            bAdmVal = UCase(CellStr(bAdmData))
                        Else
                            bAdmVal = UCase(CellStr(bAdmData(bi, 1)))
                        End If

                        If bAdmVal = UCase(ADM_EMERGENCY) Then
                            missedEM = missedEM + 1
                        ElseIf IsElectiveAdmType(bAdmVal) Then
                            missedEL = missedEL + 1
                        Else
                            missedOther = missedOther + 1
                        End If
                    Next bi
                Else
                    missedEM = bLastRow - 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Else
        missedFCSourceLabel = "manual entry (dashboard workaround)"
        missedEM = missedFCManualCount
        missedEL = 0
        missedOther = 0
    End If

    ' ---- Get report period label ----
    Dim reportLabel As String
    reportLabel = GetReportPeriodLabel(fileAws)
    If reportLabel = "" Then reportLabel = "Unknown Period"

    Dim voidedTotal As Long
    voidedTotal = voidCt(1) + voidCt(2)

    ' ---- Create output workbook ----
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim outWb As Workbook
    Set outWb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)

    ' EM sheet -- always produced
    Dim wsEM As Worksheet
    Set wsEM = outWb.Sheets(1)
    wsEM.Name = SHEET_EM
    WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEM, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EM
    HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEM

    ' EL sheet -- always produced (Revert A, 2026-07-30: no longer gated)
    Dim wsEL As Worksheet
    Set wsEL = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_EL)
    WriteFilteredFileASheet wsEL, fullData, aLastRow, outCols, secArr, SEC_EL
    HighlightCCFFallbackRows wsEL

    ' Missed FC sheet -- only when File B was provided
    If hasFileB Then
        Dim wsMissed As Worksheet
        Set wsMissed = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_MISSED_FC)
        WriteMissedFCSheet wsMissed, fileBws
    End If

    ' Summary sheet
    Dim wsSummary As Worksheet
    Set wsSummary = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_SUMMARY)
    WriteSummarySheet wsSummary, reportLabel, waterfall, _
        encCt(1), encCt(2), missedEM, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        greenCt(1), pinkCt(1), ltGreenCt(1), orangeCt(1), draftCt(1), voidCt(1), _
        greenCt(2), pinkCt(2), ltGreenCt(2), orangeCt(2), draftCt(2), voidCt(2), _
        emTeams, elTeams, blankCCF(1), blankCCF(2), _
        edInit(1), edFull(1), inflFull(1), ncidFull(1), _
        edInit(2), edFull(2), inflFull(2), ncidFull(2), _
        ncidEnc, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoid, ncidTeams, ncidBlankCCF, _
        ncidEdInit, ncidEdFull, ncidInflFull, ncidNcidFull, _
        voidedTotal, otherEncCount, missedOther, unrecognisedStatuses, unmatchedNCIDWards, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, _
        CLng(waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter")), _
        suppressTeamBlocks, rosterCoverage, unmatchedNames

    ' Methodology sheet
    Dim wsMethod As Worksheet
    Set wsMethod = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_METHODOLOGY)
    WriteMethodologySheet wsMethod, reportLabel, voidedTotal, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        inflightExceptionApplied, inflightExceptionBlocked, unrecognisedStatuses.Count, _
        CLng(waterfall("EncountersLostToModeFilter")), suppressTeamBlocks, rosterCoverage

    ' Staff Roster Check sheet
    Dim wsRoster As Worksheet
    Set wsRoster = AddSheet(outWb, SHEET_STAFF_ROSTER_CHECK)
    BuildStaffRosterCheckSheet wsRoster, fileAws, roster, unmatchedNames

    ' Activate Summary sheet
    wsSummary.Activate

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    ' ---- Save via dialog ----
    Dim defaultName As String
    defaultName = "FCReportSummary_" & reportLabel & ".xlsx"

    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogSaveAs)
    fd.title = "Save FC Completion Report"
    fd.InitialFileName = defaultName

    If fd.Show = -1 Then
        Dim savePath As String
        savePath = fd.SelectedItems(1)
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        outWb.SaveAs savePath, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
        Application.StatusBar = "Report saved: " & savePath
    Else
        MsgBox "Report was NOT saved. The output workbook is still open -- " & _
               "use File > Save As to save it manually.", vbExclamation, "Not Saved"
    End If

    Exit Function

Attribute VB_Name = "ProgressForm"
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = False
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' IMPORT NOTE (staff): This module is an Excel UserForm, NOT a
' standard module. To install it from FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt:
'   1. In the VBA Editor: Insert > UserForm.
'   2. In the Properties window (F4), set (Name) = ProgressForm.
'   3. Open the form's code window (F7) and paste everything from
'      the "Option Explicit" line above down to the end of this
'      section (skip the VERSION / Begin / Attribute lines).
' All controls are built automatically when the form opens.
' ============================================================

' Modeless progress window shown by MainMacro during GenerateFCCompletionReport.
' The macro runs with ScreenUpdating = False, so Application.StatusBar never
' repaints; this form forces a redraw via Me.Repaint on every Update.

Private m_total As Long
Private m_lblStep As MSForms.Label
Private m_barTrack As MSForms.Label
Private m_barFill As MSForms.Label

Private Const BAR_LEFT As Single = 12
Private Const BAR_TOP As Single = 44
Private Const BAR_WIDTH As Single = 192
Private Const BAR_HEIGHT As Single = 16

Public Sub ShowProgress(totalSteps As Long)
    m_total = totalSteps
    BuildControls
    m_lblStep.Caption = "Starting..."
    m_barFill.Width = 0
    Me.Show vbModeless
    Me.Repaint
End Sub

Public Sub Update(stepNum As Long, message As String)
    BuildControls
    m_lblStep.Caption = "Step " & stepNum & " of " & m_total & " -- " & message
    If m_total > 0 Then m_barFill.Width = BAR_WIDTH * (stepNum / m_total)
    Me.Repaint
    DoEvents
End Sub

Public Sub CloseProgress()
    Unload Me
End Sub

Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
    Me.Caption = "FC Completion Report -- Generating"
    Me.Width = 222
    Me.Height = 96
    Me.Font.Name = "Tahoma"
    Me.Font.Size = 9
    BuildControls
End Sub

' Builds the label + progress bar once. Guarded so it is safe to call repeatedly.
Private Sub BuildControls()
    If Not m_barFill Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Set m_lblStep = Me.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", "lblStep", True)
    m_lblStep.Left = BAR_LEFT
    m_lblStep.Top = 12
    m_lblStep.Width = BAR_WIDTH
    m_lblStep.Height = 24

    Set m_barTrack = Me.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", "barTrack", True)
    m_barTrack.Left = BAR_LEFT
    m_barTrack.Top = BAR_TOP
    m_barTrack.Width = BAR_WIDTH
    m_barTrack.Height = BAR_HEIGHT
    m_barTrack.BackColor = RGB(220, 220, 220)
    m_barTrack.BorderStyle = fmBorderStyleSingle

    Set m_barFill = Me.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", "barFill", True)
    m_barFill.Left = BAR_LEFT
    m_barFill.Top = BAR_TOP
    m_barFill.Width = 0
    m_barFill.Height = BAR_HEIGHT
    m_barFill.BackColor = RGB(0, 128, 0)
End Sub

' Block the user's X button so the window cannot be dismissed mid-run.
Private Sub UserForm_QueryClose(Cancel As Integer, CloseMode As Integer)
    If CloseMode = vbFormControlMenu Then Cancel = 1
End Sub

def norm_dash(s):
    if s is None: return ""
    s = str(s)
    s = s.replace(chr(150), "-").replace("\u2013","-").replace("\u2014","-")
    while "  " in s:
        s = s.replace("  ", " ")
    return s.strip()

def keep_mode(row):
    m = norm_dash(row[4]).upper()
    return m == FC_MODE_AH or m == FC_MODE_DOWNTIME

print("after FC Mode filter:", len(step1))

def keep_not_cancelled(row):
    v = (row[12] or "")
    return str(v).strip().upper() != "CANCELLED"

step2 = [r for r in step1 if keep_not_cancelled(r)]
print("after cancelled filter:", len(step2))

def priority(status):
    s = norm_dash(status).upper()
    if "VOID" in s or "DELET" in s:
        return 99
    table = {

        "ACKNOWLEDGEMENT BY OTHER MEANS":2,
        "ATTEMPTED - VIRTUAL FC COMPLETED, PENDING SIGNATURE":3,

        "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT IS UNABLE TO SIGN":5,
        "ATTEMPTED - UNABLE TO COMPLETE":6,
    }
    return table.get(s, 98)

# group by encounter number

    groups[enc].append(r)

winners = {}
voided_only = 0

rows_removed = 0

        winners[enc] = grp[0]
        if priority(grp[0][5]) == 99:

    # plain winner: lowest priority, tie-break larger FC ID
    best = None
    best_pri = None
    for r in grp:
        pri = priority(r[5])
        if best is None or pri < best_pri or (pri == best_pri and r[0] > best[0]):
            best = r
            best_pri = pri
    winners[enc] = best

print("dup groups:", dup_groups, "rows removed:", rows_removed)
print("voided-only (solo groups):", voided_only)

# Now EM/EL split
ADM_ELECTIVE = "ELECTIVE INPA"
def is_elective(adm):
    return (adm or "").upper().startswith(ADM_ELECTIVE)

em_count = 0
el_count = 0
other_count = 0
em_voided = 0
el_voided = 0
admtype_counts = defaultdict(int)
for enc, r in winners.items():
    adm = (r[11] or "").upper()
    admtype_counts[adm] += 1
    pri = priority(r[5])
    if adm == "EMERGENCY":
        em_count += 1
        if pri == 99: em_voided += 1
    elif is_elective(adm):
        el_count += 1
        if pri == 99: el_voided += 1
    else:
        other_count += 1

print("EM count:", em_count, "EL count:", el_count, "other:", other_count)
print("EM voided:", em_voided, "EL voided:", el_voided)
print("admtype distribution:", dict(admtype_counts))
EOF
